11— thosang bla phrothig —snye/ ——sdebane/ (16 phong —— sko sner+sharā sde la —— r+yā bskong rkye ḍi skong ——/thol glu/ ldeb/ (7) (185) 13 dpal chen brgyud 'debs/ ldeb/ (1) (199) 14 rig 'dzin thugs sgrub dpal chen 'dus pa/ldeb/ (18) (201) 15 phur pa bdud dpung zil gnon/ ldeb/ (10) (237) 15 ye shes mkha' 'gro bde chen rgyal mo'i gsol 'debs bden pa gnyis kyi myu gu dngos grub kun 'byung / ldeb/ (1) (257) 17 yum ka mtsho rgyal bde chen rgyal mo'i rtsa ba'i sgrub pa bde chen dpal phreng / — /ldeb/ (10) (261) 18 rig 'dzin yum ga'i bskang bsdus dngos grub char 'bebs/ ldeb/ (1) (281) 1'a tshogs mchod bsdus pa/ /ldeb/ (1) (285) 10 gangs chen mtsha yi zhing —ka/sna/ ldeb/ (1) (287) 11 ljo rda bcupo da bsdong dri za'i —33 mangs/

snya na/ pa pha ba lha ma/ ya 'a ra wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ lan bdun/ ye lha lha tu pra lha wā he tu: ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya bhā da ta/ te ṣañtsa yo ni ro r+sā ye waṃ bā dī ma hā za ma ṇa swa hā/ lan bdun gyis brlabs so/ / / dang po dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs rgyud bskul phyir gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bla ma mkhyen/ lan bdun gyis gdung ba drag pos bos nas/ snying dbus dad pa'i ge /sar bzhad pa nas/ /skyabs gcig drin chen bla ma yar la bzhengs/ /las dang nyon mongs drag pos gzir ba yi/ /skam ba ngan pa bdag 'a skyobs pa'i nephyir/ /spyi tho bde chen 'khor pho'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /dran dang shes bzhin kun kyang bzhengs su gsol/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo sku bzhi'i bdag nyid dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zab lam gyi rtogs pa khyad par

da' rten don yod ma byas na/ /phyi nas thar pa bsgrub ba'i rten mi rnyed/ /bde 'gro'i rten la bsod nams zad gyur nas/ /sha ba'i 'og tu ngan song ngan 'gror 'khyams/ /dge sdig mi shes chos kyi sgra mi thos/ /dge ba'i bshes dang mi mjal mtshang re che/ /sems can tsam gyi grangs dang rim pa la/ /— bsam na mi lus thob pa srid mtha' tsam/ /mi yang chos med sdig la spyod mthong na/ /chos bzhin spyod pa nyin mo'i skar ma tsam/ /blo sna chos 'a sgyur cig tsho ga ru mkhyen/ /'am gol dman par ma gtong kun mkhyen sde/ /gnyis su med do drin chen bla ma mkhyen/ /ga' te mi lus rin chen gling phyin yang / /lus rten bzang 'a byur po che yi sems/ /thar pa bsgrub ba'i rten du mi rung zhing / khyad par bdud kyis zin dang dug lnga 'khrugs/ /las ngan thog tu babs dang le yos g.yengs/ /gzhan khol bran g.yog 'jigs skyob chos ltar bcos/ /rmongs sogs 'phra' byung rkyen gyi mi khom brgyad/ /bdag 'a chos kyi

dang bya rgod khye yis 'drad pa'i dus/ /bar do'i yul na 'jigs pa zhin tu che/ /blo sna chos spru sgyur cig gu ru mkhyen/ /lam gom dman par ma gtong /kun mkhyen rje/ /gnyis su med do drin chen bla ma mkhyen/ /dge sdig las kyi rnam smin phyi bzhin 'brang / /khyad par dmyal ba'i 'jig rten nyid son na/ /2 lcags bsreg sa gzhir mtshon gyis mgo lus 'bral/ /sog les gshogs dang tho lum 'bar bas 'tshar/ /sgo med lcags khyem 'thum par 'o dod 'bod/ /tsho 'bar ba'i gas skang gis 'bugs khro chur 'tshod/ /kun nas tsha ba'i mes bsreg brgyad tshan gcig /gangs ri kug po'i 'dabs dang chu 'khyags kyi/ /gcong rong ya nga'i gnas su bu yug sbrebs/ /grang reg rlung gis btab pa'i 'ang tsho ni/ /chu bur can dang lhag par brdol ba can/ /smre ngag rgyun mi chad par 'don pa yang / /tshor ba'i sdug bsngal brnag par dka' ba yi/ /zungs kyis rab btang 'chi kha'i nad pa bzhin/ /shugs ring 'don cing so 'tham

med pa'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i/ /sa bon gti zug mun par 'khyams pa bdag /blo sna chos 'a sgyur cig gu ru mkhyen/ /'am gol dman par ma gtong kun mkhyen rje/ /gnyis su med do drin chen bla ma mkhyen/ /chos lam zhugs kyang nyes spyod mi sdom zhing / /theg chen sgor zhugs gzhan phan sems tsha dang bral/ /dbang bzhi thob kyang bskyed rdzogs mi bsgom pa'i/ /lam gol 'di las bla mas bsgra' du gsol/ /lta ba ma rtogs tho co'i spyod pa can/ /rwa sgom ba yengs skrung go yul 'ud gog 'thag /spyod pa nor spyang rang skyon mi sems pa'i/ /chos dred 'di mas bla mas bsgra' du gsol/ /nang par 'chi yang gnas gos nor la srid/ /na tshod yol yang nges 'byung skyo shas bral/ /thos pa chung yang yon tan can du sprom/ /ma rig 'di las bla mas bsgral du gsol/ /rkyen khar 'chor yang 'du 'dzi'i gnas bskor sems/ /dben pa brten skrung rang rgyud shang ltar rengs/ /du' bar smra yang chags sdang ma zhig

mthon pho bshags: phyin chad srog 'a babs kyang sdom: khyod thugs zla ba rgyas pa'i steng: lha yig mtha' mar sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pa sngags kyi rgyud bskul bas: yab yum bde rol sbyor mtshams nas: bdud rtsi byang chub sems kyi sprin: ga bur rdul ltar 'dzag pa yis: bdag dang khams gsum /la sems can gyi: las dang ston mongs sdug bsngal rgyu: nad gdon sdig sgrib nyes ltung grib: ma lus byang bar mdzad du gsol: yo bza satwa sogs 〉 yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzlas mthar/ mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis: dam tsheg las ni 'ga' zhing nyams: bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig: stagatso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste: thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can: 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi: sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig /nyams pa thams cad mthol yo bshags so/ /sdig pa dang sgrib ba zhes kung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes brjod pas/

dbyer med mtsho skyes rdo rje tha' ba'i sku: dkar dmar mdangs ldan gzhon nu'i zha tshugs can: phod kha chos gos za ber 'dung ma gsol: zha' gcig /phyag gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i stabs: phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas thod bum bsnoms: dbu po 'dab ldan pad+ma'i mnyen zhu gsol: mchan khyang g.yon na tsha bde stong yum mchog ma: sbas pa'i tshul gyis kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum bsnams: 'ja' zer khrig le 'od phung thong na bzhugs: phyi 'khor 'od lnga'i drwa bas mdzes rtsa /pa'i grong: sprul pa'i rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga dang: rgya bod paṇa grub rig 'dzin yi dam lha: mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can sprin ltar gtibs: gsal stong mnyam gnas chen po'i ngang du gsal: rgya: sgo rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po 'a: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes:/pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis: byin gyis slob phyir gshegs su gsolaḥ gu

tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyi sa thon thebs/ yongs spyod rdzogs sku'i go 'phang gi skal ba rgyud la bzhag zugs rka'i phroṃ mig nam mkha'i mdog can mas 'od zer /'phros/ rang gi snying ga nas zhugs/ yid kyi las dang jig le'i sgrib pa dag thugs rdo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/casdu bde stong tsaṇ+ḍa ri'i snod du gyur/ phyag rgya'i rig 'dzin gyi sa bon thebs/ chos sku'i go 'phang gi skal ba rgyud la bzhag slar yang thugs ku'i phroṃ 'as sbo tsho yig gnyis pa zhig skar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du chad/ rang sems dang tha dad med par 'dres/ kun gzhi'i las dang shes bya'i sgrib pa sbyangs/ ye shes lbardo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs/ tshig gis mtshon pa don dam gyi dbang thob/ ka dag rdzogs pa chen po'i snod du gyur/ lhun grub rig 'dzin gyi sa bon thebs/mthar thug gi 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku'i skal ba rgyud 'a bzhag go /de ltar 'don sgom zung du 'jug pas las dbang blangs mthar/ nam zhig tshe yi dus byas tshe:

de las ldang nas/ dpa' ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /bdag gi snying gar pad+ma'i gdan bzhugs 'a/ /bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam par thar pa 'a/ /skad cig tsam yang 'og lta mi skye zhing / /ci mdzad legs par la mthong ba'i mos gus kyis/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs sems la 'jug par shog /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang / /'bral med chos kyi dpal la yongs / spyod nas/ /sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas/ /rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog /bcu pa bsngo ba ni/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs zhing / /bsod nams ye shes las byung ba'i/ /dam pa sku gnyis thob par shog /'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang / /byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed ba dang / /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la/ /kun kyang kun nas bzang por reg gyur cig /'jam

zhi/ /sad ser dbul phongs dmag 'khrugs god kha sogs/ /'jig rten dus kyi rgyad pa ji snyed kun/ /tshes bcu'i dus mchod bzung nas gsol 'debs kyi/ /byin rlabs kho nas zhi ba mngon sum phyir/ /zha' bzhes dus pe bab bo thugs rjes gzigs/ /bod 'bangs bsam yod thams cad khyod la dad / /bsam med drin can pha ma dag la yang / /'khya bar byed na khyed kyi thugs rje 'a/ /nye ring ma mchis thugs dam rgyud bskul pho/ /bod 'bangs nam yang yal bar mi 'dor bar/ /zhal bzhes dus la bab bo thugs rjes gzigs/ /bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ zhes pa'ang bsam yas rab byung ba dbyangs yig dang po'i ming can gyi ngor rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pas so// //dge'o// //

brdungs pas/ /srid gsum dbyings su sgrol ba'i mthu thob pa/ /pra chen ha :'i zhabs spru gsol ba 'debs/ /shar sto lhun grub brtsegs pa'i dur khrod du/ /sprod gtong ma mo'i dga' mar rtag rol ba/ /zag med bde chen lang tsho rab rgyas pa/ /snya na saṃ skyi'i zhabs spru gso' ba 'debs/ /lho nub gsang chen snyo rol ba'i dur khrod du/ /yon tan bdud rtsi'i bcud la yongs spyod pas/ /'phro med 'ja' lus mchog gi skur bzhengs pa/ /khri ma mi tra'i zhabasal gsol k+ta ba 'debs/ /nub byang he chen brda' ba'i dur khrod du/ /'jig rten mchod bstod dpung tshogs rab rngams pas/ /ma rung bdud sde'i g.yum ngo pham byas tshopa/ /rom bu gu gya'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /byang shar 'jig rten brtsegs pa'i dur khrod du/ /drag sngags dmod ba'i me dpung rab spar bas/ /phas rgo' rtsi shing bsreg pa'i mthu thob pa/ //sto gaba'i zhabs 'a gsol ba 'debs/ /sku gsum rgyal ba'i zhing khams thams cad du/ /sgrub sde brgyad la

—————— ————— —————————————————— 7———— ————— ———— ————— ————— —— — — stse/ /du ldog cing / /'gyur med thugs kyi yi gir byin slobs/ /khyod la gsol 'debs byin gyis sprobs zhig//gnubs kyi rigs 'khrungs dge slong chen po/ /sto brag mkhar chur yang dag grub brnyes/ /nyi zer spru chibs nam /mkha'i snying por/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis sprobs zhig /gnubs yul rong byon sangs rgyas ye shes/ /sgrags snye/ kyi yongs rdzong gzhin rje'i gshed grub/ /mthu stobs brag 'a phur pa 'debs der/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis — —————— ———————— rdo dra — —————— ——— — —1de la — ————— —— — —— ———— —— —— 1—

rlobs sheg /dbu dur ngan lam rigs 'khrungs snyi cu/ /dben rtsar pad+ma dbang chen grub brnyes/ /rta skad gtsug bton rgyal mchog dbyangs der/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs zhig /sgrags mdar nus ldan mkhar chen rgyud 'khrungs/ /mon kha ni ring phrin las phur grub/ /'tsho rgyal bsad pa'i mi ro slong der/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shag /yar stod sham po gangs kyi ra bar/ /srid pa bde 'gro mngon par grub mdzad/ /ma mo mngon khol 'brog mi dpal yer/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shag /spa gro stag tshang bsam grub ke'u tshang / /dregs pa'i bdag po mngon bar grub mdzad/ /lha srin bran khol dpal gyi seng ger/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs sheg /g.ya' ma lung dang 4 yum lcang rar/ /stobs ldan nag po mngon bar grub mdzad/ /ye shes spyan ldan be+e ro tsa nar/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs zhig /rigs gsum dba' gyi bsam yas dbu rtser/ /rdo

phyin pa'i tshe/ /kun dga'i mtshan can mkhas btsun grags pa yis/ /gang 'a rang shes sna tshogs rang grol btags/ /gsang sngags phyi nang dgongs pa mkha' ltar gsa'/ /sna tshogs rang grol zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dwags la sgam por phyag chen chos la phyin/ /sangs rgyas mtshan can sgrub brgyud bla ma yis/ /rigs rtsal sgo dbye'i nam mkha'i rnal 'byor btags/ /rlung sems dbang thob dbu ma'i mdud ba grol/ /nam mkha'i rnam 'byor zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rtse thang gnas bzhir yon tan grags pa rgyas/ /phyi nang grub mtha' kun 'a thogs med byung / /slob dpon dgyes nas phan pa bzang por btags/ /rgyal ba'i gdung 'dzin bstan pa'i srog shang 'dzin/ /phan pa bzang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /sto brag phyogs phyin gu ru'i lha khang du/ /'byung gnas rdo rje chos dbang rgyud dang mja'/ /bka' brgyad yongs rdzoḍa rgyud sde ma lus gsan/ /bla rma dgyes nas gu yangs blo bde btags/

yon/ /bsam bzhin skyes nas 'gro ba'i dpal du shar/ /gang spru gang 'dul zab mo'i gter sgo phyes/ /smo rgyan thugs sras pad+ma gling par grags/ /'gro cha ba'i mun sel bstan pa'i sgron me mdzad/ /pad+ma gling pa'i zhabs 'a gsol ba 'debs/ /'di phyi kun tu rig 'dzin khyed sku dang / /'bral med zab sdo gter snying po'i don 'grub cing / /mi sgom mi sgrub mi 'bral don mthong nas/ /skyabs chen khyed dang dbyer med smin grol shog /dge'o/ /hūṃ

/snying po'i ring lugs bslang nas slar/ /gshe zhing bskur pa 'debs pa rnams kyi don/ /sprul pa sna tshogs ston la gsol ba 'debs/ /mdor na 'od srung drung /du sems bskyed nas/ /byang chub sbyod ba rlabs chen rdzogs ba'i mthar/ /rnam par rgyal ba can du 'tshang rgya ba'i/ /'dus pa dang po'i 'khor du skye bar shog /ci mdzad legs par mthong ba'i dad gus kyis/ khyod zha' yid 'a byed pa la goms bas/ /bla ma mchog dang nam yang mi 'bral zhing / /tshom bu tsho yotsho gcig tu mngon par sangs rgyas shog /ces pa'ang rje btsun dz+nyā na'i ming can sogs dad ldan 'gas bskul ba las/ /'khrul snang la shar tshod tsam sor bzhag nas mkhyen — brtse'i lhas so/ sarba mang ga la/ /

lung bstan thob pa'i mod/ /ji lta ji snyed thobs pa'i gter grol te/ /mngon pa'i nga rgyal zad la gsol ba 'debs/ /rnying bstan ri mo'i mar me ltar gyur dus/ /rgyud 'bum glegs bam rdzogs dang chos 'byung bskrun/ /mdo rgyud sems gsum snying tigabaka' gter gyi/ /bstan pa ma nor 'dzin spru gsol — ba 'debs/ /snga 'gyur grub mtha' chos lugs sna tshogs kyis/ /rnyog mar gyur 'a gzhan sdes gsung ba'i tshe/ /yon tan rin chen mdzod kyi zhing rta 〉 che/ /rang sde'i grub mtha' slong la gsol ba 'debs/ /thos pa gung dang blo gros sgrun po rnams/ /khron pa'i 'ag 'gro rmongs ba'iphyogs 'dzin yang / / chemakhas dang dam pa'i rgyu skar chen po'i dbus/ /bstan pa'i rnyan byed 'bar la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang zhig 'phags pa'i spangs rtogs brnyes pa /rnams/ /rnam rtog rang rgyud las 'das chos nyid phyir/ /sgom byung shes rab zla ba nya gang nas/ /chos kyi gter mdzod rnyed 'a gsol ba 'debs/ /

sems dpa' che/ /yum de'i dpon bla snying po snang mdzad dang / /rdo yul stod du so skyes 'phags pa'i tshul/ /kun bzang gzhan la phan der gsol ba 'debs/ /gzhan yang dkar nag las kyi tshon sna yis/ /sngags pa'i rang gzugs brjod pas mthar 'das kyang / /byang sems dngul chu dman dris ma gos pa'i/ /phan bde rtsa lag de la gsol ba 'debs/ /'di 'og ting 'dzin rnam gsum rol rtsa' yang / /sku gsum ston pa'i phrin las pho nya ba/ /sna tshogs 'phrul gyi byed po phan bde'i bdag/ /phunatshogs 'byung gnas de 'a gsol ba 'debs/ /nge ltar gsol ba btab pa'i mthu nus kyis/ /skye ba'i phreng rāb bla ma dam pa dang / /'bral med rim dgu'i theg par yongs spyod nas/ /sa bcu lam lnga'i dpal yon mthar phyin zhog/ /'di nyid dbu mdzad 'jigs med chos dar gyis bskul ngor/ kun bzang gzhan phan gyis bris pas kun nas kun tu dge bar gyur cig /dge 'o/ /
—— ——————————— —— ——— ———— —༄/ /rnam thar gsom 'debs byin rlabs 'gugs ba'i lcags myu bzhugs/ /

dū/————/kyi ge snye dorne/ /mtha' gye zhermerme cad gnyere rkyene rme kyang /—/—— sa sras rje 'bangs thun ba'i sku/ /zab gter sgo 'byed tshogs 'a gsol ba 'debs/ /deng dus lnga phrag tha ma'i sems can kun/ /bzod dka'i sdug bsngal me chen mched pa'i tshe/ /dri med dga' rab pad 'byung be+e ma la'i/ /sprul pa r+sāphyog gaspra4tsho/———/snags gtsonasakyi 'dzin ste/bhe ——/gzhupor+shardo—————— — —————— ————————— — ————————— —————— ————

/gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gram 'grim/ /zla bcu'i dus su mkha' 'gro'i dbang bskur ba'i/ /rang byung sprul pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /bgrang bya cha gsum nas dpa' ri rig 'dzin zhing / /sprul gzhir mja' nas dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs/ /dpa' tho mkha' 'gro dregs ldan tshogs kun gyis/ /mel 8 tshes rtag tu skyong der gsol ba 'debs/ /sngon gnas rjes dran rigs bdag bla ma btsal/ /thugs brtses rjes bzung bdud kyi g.yul 'as rgyal/ /chos kyi rdo bdag mo rigs kyi myu gu btsas/ /rten 'brel dus su smin der gsol ba 'debs/ /gzhon nu'i dus nas nges 'byung skyo shas kyis/ /rgyud bskul nyin snang sgyu sbyitsho ma rmi lam bzhin/ /mtshan snang sku dang 'ja' zer jig mer 'dres/ /sngon 'as dus su smin der gsol ba 'debs/ /bcu gsum yon nas bskyed rdzogs lam 'a zhugs/ /nyin dus rigs bdag bla ma'i zhal khrid dang / /mtshan snang dpa' bo blo mis brda sprod pa'i/ /sa 'am skad cig bgrod der gsol ba

mthong / /thod gi' nyams snang gong 'phel mtha' rdzogs ba'i/ /'khrul zhig 'ja' lus rdo rje 'a gsol ba 'debs/ /rmi lam 'od gsal nyams kyi snang tho ba 'a/ /bde byed brtsegs dang mkha' spyod sa spyod gnas/ /rig 'dzin dpa' tho mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gral 'grim/ khrag 'thung dpa' bo'i zhabs 'a gsol ba spra 'debs/ /tha snyad shes bya'i gnas 'a ma sbyangs kyang / /lhan skyes ye shes bde ba chen bro yis/ /yongs spyod 'khor lo'i rtsa 'khor yongs zhig pa'i/ /rdo bde ba'i rdo rje dpa' der gsol ba 'debs/ /ngo tho chos sku rgya' sar mnga' brnyes kyang / /ma dag 'gro ba'i mos blo mthun snang dang / /'tshams par lngurtsa gang 'a gang 'dul don mthod pa'i/ /mthu stobs dpa' bo'i zhabs ma gsol ba 'debs/ /yang gsang lus med mkha' 'gro'i thugs jig chos/ /man ge ngag snyan brgyud yi ge med pa'i skor/ /dbang rab skal ldan don du legs bstan nas/ /'ja' lus 'od sku'i lam ston gsol ba 'debs/ /gzugs

zhi: drug pa byin 'bebs ni: rgyaḥ stong nyid dbyings las thugs rje rol pa'i rtsal: 'gag med mkha' 'a char sgrin gtibs pa bzhin: kun rdzob mtshan ma'i rdzas kun byin brlabs pas: gdod nas dag ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por gyur: yo ca na badz+ra ā the zha ya phe phe sarba sa ma ya dzaḥ bdun pa mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni: yo āḥrgya: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rngos ma lus pa: rnam pa rdzas spru ngo bo ye shes kyi: bdud rtsi chen po ro brgya'i /rudabal 'dzin bas: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes pa'i dpyid du gyur: yo badz+ra martse nas shaba'i bar dang / sarba pañtsa rak+ta ba lit+ta ma hā su kha tho dza āḥ lurgya: lan gsum gyis brlabs: gnyis pa dngos gzhi la rnam grangs bdun las: dang po rten dang rten pa bskyed pa ni: hrīḥ chos kun mi dmigs gzhi med rtsa bral ngang : dbyings rig zung 'jug dag pa chen po'i zhing : rang snang lhun grub ri bo po ta na: brda rtags mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor dbus:

sna tshogs pad+ma stong ldan nyi zla'i steng : sgyuḥ'as rang nyid 'phags mchog snying rje'i lha: sdug bsngal rang gro' spyan ras gzigs dbang sku: zhal gcig //phyag bzhi mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs: rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis thugs rkar thal sbyar tshul: lhag ma 〈khu sar pa nyadang phyag stabs gcig rnam gnyis bgrang phreng /— pad dkar 'chang : yongs spyod rdzogs sku dar dang rin chen mdzes: dkar dmar mdangs ldan rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras: zhi tshul dgu dang rgyan cha bcu shelha gsum mdzes: dbu gtsug rigs bdag 'od dpag med pas mtshan: phyogs bzhir pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i gdan steng du: shar du rje btsun sgron ma sku mdog sta/dkar: sto ru 'od zer can ma gser gyi mdog: nub tu ku ru kusle pad rag mdangs: byang du nor rgyun lha mo sku mdog ljang : kun skrung rang rang rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs: sgo bzhir dbang chen sde bzhi las mdog can: gro gug thod 'dzin dor stabs 'jigs tshul rngams: khro bo'i chas rdzogs me dpung

skye: 'bu' yo bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub rgyol: sarba pañtsa rak+ta ba yirta ma hā su kha dharmā ṅgārtu bla jo ho: bdun pa bstod pa ni: hrī: chos spro dbyings spros pa bral ba'i phro brang nas: lhun grub yongs spyod rdzogs pa'i mnga' dbang can: tshad med snying rje'i gter chen sbyan ras gzigs: sdug sdu bsngal rang grol sku 'a phyag 'tshal bstod: tshad med bzhi yis 'gro kun thar lam 'dren: gang la gang 'dul thugs rje rol pa'i gar: cir ya nga bsgyur ②spra ba'i mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul can: rigs bzhi'i sems ma rnams 'a phyag 'tshal bstod: rnam bzhi'i grin las kun la dbang bsgyur zhing : log 'dren 'dul dziphyir khro gtum rol pa'i stabs: thogs med bsgyur ba'i rigs bzhi'i h+ya gyi: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstodabyi brgyad pa dzab ni:rang nyid zugs rje chen po'i thugs ka ru: nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor yangs pa'i dbus: zla ba'i steng na thugs srog hrīḥdakar po: de rnga thar yi gi bdun

dmigs gnad dmar byang gnad yig las: rtogs par bya ba kho na'o: sa ma ya: 'di ltar shin tu zab pa'i gnad: 'phags mchog sdug bsngal rang 'grol gyi: sgrub thabs rje btsun ma hā gu rus: mnga' bdag chos rgyal yab sras la: bar khang g.yu zhal 'bar ba ru: gdams te snying mdzod sgrom bur stsal: smon lam gtad rgya'i mthu btsan po:dus bab sa pho stag gi lo: thugs rje chen po'i zhal mthong zhing : ye shes dbyings kyi ḍāk+ki mas: 'od gsal sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i klong : klong gsal brda ris zhog dril sprad:bde don gab sbas med par bkod: bka' srung gza' bdud chen po yis: shin tu zab pa'i gter gyi bcad: g.yel med skyongs shig sa ma ya: lo bdun gsang rgya byas nas gtan la phab : snying las gces pa'i gdams pa'o:

par gsol ba 'debs/ /tshad med rnam bzhi'i dge tshogs 'gro la bsngo/ /zhes brjod cing bskang ba dngos la 'jug pa ni/ hrīḥ 'jig rten khams kyi dag byed che chung chab/ /chu dang thang skyes me tog sna tshogs rigs/ /rang bzhin ngad ldan spros dang sbyar spros tshogs/ /mun pa sem byed nyi zla sgron me sogs/ /bzang po dri ldan gtsang chab sbyar ba'i dri/ /bza' bca' ldag gzhibs lha mi'i zhal zas rigs/ /'bud dkrol snyan 'jibs rol mo'i tshogs rnams kyis/ / dz+wasdug bsngal rang grol lha tshogs thugs dam bskang / /rigs bdag 'chi med mgon po'i thugs dam bskang / /'khor gyi lha mo rnam bzhi'i thugs dam bskang // snosgo srung rta mgrin rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang / /thugs dam bskang ngo phyi nang gsang ba yi/ /dam tshog nyam sa chags zhes ku nga yo ngas dag nas/ /mchos dang thun mong dngos grub thob pa dang / /thugs rje chen po'i grin las yongs grub mdzod/ spyoḥ /mig shes 'jug yul gzuḍa rnams thams cad dang /

song gnas gsum snyeg /sdug bsngal brjod dka' ya re nga / /de dag rang byas las 'bras yin/ /don la rang snang mthu brtas ba'i/ /tho yor mi dang thag khrar sprul/ /'khrul ngor snang bzhin shes mdzod spru/ /rang rig yengs med ngang nyid nas/ /lha dang bla mar gsol ba thob/ /lan gsum brjod cing tshe 'das kyis/ /brjod par bsam rjes ā da r+sha/ /mtshan byang shar ba bkru bya shing / phroṃ/ 'di ni byams dang brtse ba'i 'phrul/ /sprul sku'i rol rtsal chu rgyun gyis/ /khyod kyi phung khams skye mched kun/ /ma dag sgrib tshogs dag gyur cig/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me phroṃ/ tshe 'das kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas dus gsum kun tu lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib sarba shu sha ye swā hā/ phroṃ/ 'di ni lhun grub dbyings snang rtsa'/ /'gags med 'ongs sku'i chu rgyun gyis/ /khyod kyi rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyi/ /ma dag sgrib tshogs dag gyur cig /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me phroṃ/ oṃ phroṃ ṭ+wāṃ sgyuḥ.āḥ tshe 'das kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med

med pa nas dus gsum kun tu dug lnga'i 'as bsags pa thams cud shārnyi ku ru ye tī hā/ gong gi khrus sngags gsum po dang / /'og gi dug sbyangs sngags dang bcas/ /so so'i skabs su gsum gsam bzlas/ /de nas rigs drug gnas 'dren ni/ /sa bon drug po'i steng du ni/ /mtshan byang rim bzhin spo ba dang / /mgron rigs tsha drug la rim bzhin 'bul/ /dang po dmyal ba'i sgrib sbyang ni/ r+bha/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ldan pa'i/ /gtor ma mkho dgu phun tshogs gter/ /tshe 'das zhe dz+watsho snang las bsags pa'i/ /lan chags sha 'khon sbyang phyir bsngo/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa pho ke te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra phroṃ/ /zhes brjod gtor ma 5bsngos 'phral du/ /dmyal ba'i thub pa'i dbang bskur te/ phroṃ/ zhe snang rnam dag 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i sku/ /dmyal ba'i thub pa me chu'i phyag mtshan bsnams/ //tshe 'das rigs kyi bu 'a dbang bskur bas/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i gsang gsum dbang thob shog/ oṃ mu ne+e ye hwa hā/ oṃ da ha da ha sarba na raka ga te he tra /

oṃ sarba be+e dan khaṅge tshe tshe phroṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod lha min 'khor ba dong sprugs bsam/ r+ghaṃ/ nyon cig tshe 'das lus brjes rigs kyi bu/ /lhan skyes kun brtag mthu brtas rgyu 'bras kyi/ /phrag dog 'khon 'dzin las kyis 'phangs pa'i 'gro/ /lha min yu' skyes 'thab rtsod bzod dka' yang / /la kha'i tho yor mi 'khrul sangs pa bzhin / /lha min yul spang rnam dag zhing khams snyogs/ /ces mtshan byang gnas spro bgegs gtor btang / phroṃ/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ldan ba'i/ /gtor ma mkho dgu phun tshogs gter/ /tshe 'das nga rgyal las bsags pa'i/ /lan chags sha 'khon sbyang phyir bsngo/ na maḥsarba ta thā sogs/ /zhes bsngo lha yi thub pa'i dbang / lhu/ nga rgyal rnam dag 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i sku/ /lha yi thub ba po waṃ phyag mtshan can/ /tshe 'das rigs kyi bu 'a dbang bskur bas/ /rin chen 'byung ldan gsang gsum dbang thob shog /oṃ mu ni peṃ swa hā/ oṃ sarba su kha sarba rkarma tshi tshi su phaṭa swā hā/ /ces brjod lha

be+e ska sku ṣa tshe tshe r+bha phaṭa/ /ces brjod mi yi 'khor ba dong sprug bsam/ : nyon cig tshe 'das lus brjes rigs kyi bu/ /sgo lnga'i rnam shes yul lnga'i //rjes 'brang bas/ /tshogs drug yu' 'a chags sdang byas 'bras kyis/ /mi lus skyes nas sdug bsngal bcu gcig 'a/ /rtag tu spyod pa brjod dka'i gnas — yin kyang / /rang grib mthong tshe de nyid dgrar bzung ba/ /ji bzhin rtogs ltar ngar 'dzin thong marjod 'a/ /phyag na pad+ma'i go sar spebs bar mdzod/ / shi〉 de nas gshin por dbang bskur tshe/ /yan lag bdun pa'i tshogs bsags ni/ na mo/ mchog gsum rtsa gsum ngo tho nyid/ /sdug bsngal rang grol lha tshogs 'a/ / sgophyag 'tshal skyabs mchi zhes tshogs bshags/ /mchod tshogs kun 'bum chos 'khor bskor/ /dge la yi rang rtag brtan bzhuḍa/ /bsod nams 'gro 'a phan phyir bsngo/ zhes brjod dal gyi shar sgo ru/ / dbang stegs pad+ma 'dab brgyad la/ /tshe 'das mngon sum ltar gsal la/ /mig dar dgab cing sngags 'di brjod/ /oṃ /

'khor ba thog ma med pa nas dus gsum kun tu lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas bsags ba'i sdig sgrib thams cad shurnye shu ya swā hā/ /zhes bkru/ dug dbyung ni/ ma rig rtsa' snang 'od lnga po/ /bdag gir bzung bas rab 'thas ba'i/ /phyi nang 'byung ba lnga phrag zung/ /dug lnga'i skyed byed bskyed yul gyi/ / pha ma ji bzhin gyur pa'i dug /lha sngags ting 'dzin rol rtsal gyis/ /dug byung dug lnga'i sgrib tshogs kun/ /'byung ba so so'i dbyings su dag /dug po'adzin mkha' ltar stong gyur cig /ces dang bzlas byes brab la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me r+bha/ tshe 'das kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas dus gsum kun tu dug lnga'i rme las bsags ba thams cad shān+ti ku ru ye tī hā/ gtor ma oṃ āḥthe gis brlab la/ lhu/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ldan pa'i/ /gtor ma na kho dgu phun tshogs gter/ /tshe 'das nyon drug las bsags pa'i/ /lan chags sha 'khon sbyang phyir bsngo/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sogs zhes bsngo/ thub pa drug gi sku

don dam bstod pa ni: hrīḥ ma bcos spros bral 'od gsal chos sku'i ngang: rnam mang rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dkyi' 'khor rdzogs: sku gsum 'du 'bram med pa'i bla ma la: kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam du bstod par bgyi bcu pa dzab kyi dgongs pa ni: thugs rkar jig le 'od lnga'i klong: ye shes sems dpa' kunatu bzang:mthong gsal mnyam gzhag phyag rgya can: de yi tsit+ta'i gur khang dbus: pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng: lhu yig mtheng ga'i mtha' skor du: rig 'dzin li'adus pa'i srog sngags kyis: bskor ba'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros: dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad dang: khyad par 'od gsal rdzogs chen gyi: mirig 'dzin brgyud ba'i thugs rgyud bskul: tshur 'dus bdag spru khrim pa yis: mchog thun dngos grub thob par dmigs: yo maḥ4 ma hā gu ru tsā na /so: rgya: rtsa sngags yig 'bru bcu gnyis pa: 'bru 'bum dag tu bsnyen par bya: bsnyen sgrub las gsum chig chod yin:('od zer 'phros pas bde gshegs mchod pas bsnyen

'dzin bla ma yi dam rnga ki'i tshogs/ /'dod yon tshogs 'a spyan 'dren gshegs su gso'/ /gu ru ca na badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ gsum pa chogs phud /'bul ba ni/ hrīḥ kun grub rdo rje phung po'i bya ru/ /phung khams skye mched rang gsa' gtor mar shar/ /bla ma spru' sku'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang / /gdan gsum lha skur smin pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /'od gsa' ma ba chu ti'i bha ru/ /zag bcas 'gro 'ong rlung khams gtor mar shar/ /bla shim yongs spyod rdzogs sku'i thugs dam bskang / /srog rtsom dbu mar bram pa'i dngos grub rtsol/ /rtsa gsum 'khor pho bzhi yi bya ru/ /lugs 'byung jig zoske rnam bzhi gtor mar shar/ /bla ma chos spyi sku yi thugs dam bskang / /lhan skyes bde ba chen po'i dngos grub rgya'/ /snying dbus mi zhigs phyag rgya'i bya ru/ /dug gsum rtog tshogs rang grol gtor mar skar/ /bla ma ngo bro nyid sku'i thugs dam bskang / /ka dag lhun grub dbyer med dngos grub rgya'/ /

pa'i cho gas lam dbang yang blang bar bya'o/ /drug pa lhag ma bsngo ba ni/ ma kā ros brlab/ t+pa t+pa/ gcig dang du ma las 'das ye shes gar/ /dkyil 'khor ri mu ran skyong ba'i lhag rtsad tshogs/ /'dir gshegs dpa' gyi pham phab 'di yongs la/ /byang chub sgrub la 'tshe ba'i bar chad srungs/ /yums ba lo rwa ta khā haṃ/ /bdun pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/ gdung ba'i dbyangs dang rol mor bcas/ hrīḥ ka dag nang gsal khyad chos drug ldan las / /lhun grub phra ba'i tshwaspra ye shes chen po'i rtsal/ /zung 'jug kha sbyor yan 'ag bdun gyi gar/ /rig 'dzin bla ma'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs/ /'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i chilha gseng 'am nas/ /snang bzhi mthar phyin d+me med bshes gnyen zhabs/ /'ja' lus 'pho chen rdo rje'i rol mo can/ /kun mkhyen bla ma'i thugs rje'i dus 'a /bab/ /rgya' bstan snyigs mar gyur ba'i gzhan dbang gis/ /yid dpyod mtshan za'i gdung bas nyam thag tshe/ /mgon po khyod las skyabs gzhan ma mchis /

rig 'dzin 'jigs bral gling pa yis/ /klong gsal dgongs pa'i gter rgya bkrol ba'i dus/ /bstan pa skyong bar khas blangs dam can kun/ /mchod 2 /gtor bzhes 'a phan bde'i dga' ston sgrubs/ /dgu pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ bzhal chu oṃ maḥlha gis brlab/ sgyuḥ lugs 'byung rten 'brel bcu gnyis snang / cha kun/ /bde stong tir khrim ba'i ye shes rtsal/ /bod skyong brtan ma'i tshogs rnams gtor ma yongs/ /gangs can skye 'gro bde ba'i phrin las bosdu mdzod/ /ma ma hri lhu ba lo ta khā haṃ/ bcu pa mnan pa bya ba ni/ sgyuḥ rnam thar gsum ldan rdo rje btsun mo'i grong / /gnyis 'dzin yog 'dren dam lnga0 sri 'byung po kun/ /mnan no ka dag don gyi rgyas btab bas/ /byang chub bar du ldang bar ma gyur cig /sku bya ya nan/ bcu gcig dngos grub blang ba ni/ mchod cing bstod la/ bīḥ gdod nas grol ba'i rig pa byang chub sems/ /'gag med ཿ 'phrul rdo rje'i ro' mocan/ /rig 'dzin bla ma'i dkyil

ro gcig pas/ /gang 'dul thabs mkhas 'jug ba'i grin las kyis/ /rtag tu 'gro ba'i don 'a spyod par bya/ /badz+ra tsha na rgyu/ bcu bzhi bsngo smon bya ba ni/sgyuḥ rtag dang chad pa'i pha mtha' las brgal ba/ /rim gnyis zung 'jug dge tshogs ci mchis pa/ /'khor gsum yongs grol dbyings su bsngos pa'i mthus/ /kun kyang rnam kun mchog ldan thob par shog /bco lnga shes pa brjod pa ni/ sgyuḥ gdod ma'i mgon po kun bzang 'od mtha' yas/ /sgru 'phrul dra ba'i bdag nyid rdo rje sems/ /dbyer med rig 'dzin bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis/ /dgongs brgyud 'phro ba thob pa'i bkra zhis shog /sgrib gnyis gzung 'dzin 'ching ba dbyings su zhi/ /ka dag lhun grub dbyer med rtogs pa rgyas/ /rang snang dbang 'dus rlung sems dbu mar bsgral/ /mchog gi phrin las 'grub ba'i bkra skas zhog /gzhan yang shis brjod ci rigs pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ /bcu drug phan yon bstan pa ni/ rdo rje drwa ba las/ bsod nams nang nas tshogs

dad pa brtan pos sbo ba'i skal bzang cung zad thob pa gzhon nu 'jigs med mkhyen brtse'i zlos gar gyis rang lo bcu bdun par dben pa'i brag skyibs zhig tu gang shar yud tsam la sbyar ba las thar yang gsal bar bgyis pa'o/ /

chen theg dgu'i zab lam rdzogs ba che'i/ /lung mchog rdo rje snying po'i rnam 'byor grub/ /lung rigs man ngag rgyal po'i dgongs pa brnyes/ /yung rtogs bstan pa'i nyi ma'i thugs dam bskang / /yu rgyan pa ka ra'i gsang gsum 'phrul/ /mu rgyan ring lugs snga 'gyur bstan srog 'dzin/ /sku rgyan rig /'dzin bye ba'i gtsug na mdzes/ /rgya rgyan bstan 'dzin nor bu'i thugs dam bskang / /'jam dpal spa ba'i nyi ma'i sna 'phrul gar/ /'jam dbal mkhyen libartse'i ga byin thugs la sem/ /'jam dpal mchod pa'i sgra dbyangs gsung la mnga'/ /'jam dpa' dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang / /pad+ma ltar pedag byang chub sems mchog 'byongs/ /pad+ma'i ro bcud theg dgu'i chos tshu' rdzogs/ /pad+ma 'a 'khor skam bzang rkang drug smin/ /pad+ma bde chen bzang po'i thugs dam bskang / /sdom gsum gnang bkag skyon bral rdo rje 'dzin/ /sdom byed bslab pa gsum gyi rtsal chen rdzogs/ /sdom bya gzung 'dzin 'khrul /

rgyal rgya mtsho'i dgongs don thugs dbyings gtams/ /chos mchog rim dgu'i theg pa'i gru char gyis/ /chos 'dod skal bzang pho tog phyogs bcur smin/ /tha chos rje gzhan phan snang ba'i thugs dam bskang / /bstan ba ris med thos bsam phyogs med mdzad/ /bstan pa mi nub bshad sgrub rgyal mtshan bsgrengs/ /spra bstan pa'i snying po snga 'gyur ring phugs spel/ /bstan 'dzin kun bzang dpal ldan thugs dam bskang / /byar med med byung ma ti'i gsang 'am nas/ / — / bya rtsol dgu phrug btang nas mnyam par bzhag /bya bral ka dag chos sku'i grub mtha' stogs/ /bya btang kun dga' dpa' ldan thugs dam bskang / /thub trelha chen gtsug phud can gyi mkhyen brtse'i 'phrul/ /thub dbang bstan pa 'khor pho gsum gyis the'/ /thub ba'i bstan 'dzin yongs gyi bla na mdzes/ /thub bstan chos kyi rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang / /rnam snang 'o chen gsang gsum gcig bsdus gar/ /rnam zang mkhas grub bye ba'i gtsug na mdzes/ /rnam dag

/ hrīḥ thugs dam skong ba'i snyi nang mchod pa ni/ /tshogs drug snang ba dbyings su khrim pa las/ /gang zhar 'dod yon rgyan gyi rol mo'i sprin/ /ri mi zad nam mkha' mdzod kyis thugs dam bskang / /mchod yon zhabs bsem me tog bdug sbos dang / /mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo'i sgra/ /bkra spra sa rdzas rtags rin chen rnam bdun sogs/ /lha rdzas phyi yi mchod pas thugs dam bskang / /snang stong sgru ma'i gzugs dang rā da'i sgra/ /bde chen tshul yishā khrims dri dang dga' bzhi'i ro/ /rab 'bar gtum mo'i reg bya chos kyi dbyings/ /rang byung nang gi mchod bas thugs dam bskang / /khams lnga dbu mar lngatshi /sbyar ba'i ma mṛ ta/ /rlung bcu dbyings su bsgral pa'i dmar chen po/ /zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i ba r+ya ta/ /lhan skyes gsang ba'i mchod pas thugs dam bskang / /ka dag 'od gsam dbyings kyi gnas lugs rtogs/ /lhun grub rig pa chos zad chen por smin/ /'khore 'das gzhi gro' gzhon nu bum

)ga gi rig 'dzin bla ma brgyud pa'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang ba'i rim pa mkha' spyod ḍā gi'i thol glu zhes bya ba 'di'ang theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa kun mkhyen bla ma dgyes pa'i 'bangs 'jigs pa med pa'i sdes phyogs bral gyi rgyal khams nyul ba'i skabs/ rgyal ba gnyis pa dri med 'od zer gyis sde gsum rdzogs pa chen po'i seng ge'i sgra dbyangs kyis bsil ldan smongs kun khyab par mdzad pa'i gnas gangs ri thod dkar 'od zer sprin gyi skyed mos tshal du rnam 'phyang lo'i sa zla phyi ma'i dmar phyogs ḍā gi 'du ba'i dus kyi mchod pa tshwachen po'i nub mor snang gsal zhig gi ngogs su shar mar sbyar ba dza yaskyi/ /sarba bā mnalo/ / hā

skye: 'dus —4'i ge mede che log 'geb ྅the:mamed: zhinatugasangalte ngatswa rnya du snying stobs bskyed: sa ma ya: dang po dbon zhing nyams dga'i gnas: grub thob zhabs kyis bcag pa dang: khyad par dur khrod rtsub 'gyur tshal: dkyil 'khor rtsibs bcu sgo rdzogs can: mtshan nyid tshang bar bris pa'i steng: sgrub rdzas thod sku sngags byang dang: tsan dan 'am ni seng phur sogs: spros bcas sgrub yig ltar du'am: yang na gtso sgyur tsam la brten: nyer spyod

skye: pa'i gegs: nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi: phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos: ma chags spyod la rjes yi rangs: dag pa'i mtha' tsā bzhi dri rme med: rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do: bde gshegs dbang phyug sems can la: dgos pa gsum phyir lus 'bul yo: tshe rabs bgrang spra ba'i las rnams kun: bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo: bzhi pa bgegs gter gtong ba ni: :: nga ni spyi dpal chen po ste: byang chub bsgrub spru bar 6de reX gcod ba'i: gnod byed phog 'dren 'byung po rnams: gtor ma longs la phyir dengs shag: gal te bka' las 'da' byed rnamasaḥ rme go bo tshal pa tri/snatsho brgyar bkas skang: lus ni rdul phran bzhin du bzhig: drag sngags me dpung thun bcas brdeg: yo badz+ra ma hā kro snya pad+ma kro snyi zhwa lbi badz+ra kri yi kli la ’ /ya ma hā yas kā la r+sha pa kerma ra raṃ dz+wa la raṃ phroṃ phaṭa: lnga pa mtshams gcod srung 'khor ni: rgya: bdag nyid zhe sdang rdo rje yi: spyan mig nyi zla 'bar zhing

ko mas rus ba'i ri dbang bang rim can: ra las bskal mi rab 'bar rngam ba da klong: : las gnam lcags rdo rje'i brag chen steng: nam mkha'i ————dbyings nas bh+rūṃ yig lnga ldan babs: : rat+na bha dz+nya na tsa kra maṇ+ḍal :: : yig gnas 'gyur sprul pa'i gzhal med khang: phyi ni rin chen nang ni snye thod pa'i mkhar: gru bzhi sgo bzhi tshad dang mtshan nyid lda na: gu ṇa twa ra rta babs bang rim brgyad: chos 'khor ri dwags gdugs dang chor bu'i tog: yophyi rol rin chen rtsig pa'i ming gi gzhi: 'dod snam dmar por lha mo bcu drug 'khod: pha gu ser po dra ba dra phyed mdzes: gar bu mdang yab khang tshabartsegs rdo rje'i tog: nang ni dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal med khang: phyi 'khor ro gling brgyad dang rdo rje'i gur: bskal me 'ur 'ur chem chem 'bar ba'i klong: 'og min gsang chen rol pa'i phyo brang ni: rab 'jigs gnam lcags tsa kra rtsibs brgyad dbus: bde chen kun tu bzang rngo 'i e klong du ཿ byol /

skye: song gtso rnams dregs pa che dgu brdzis: ma chagasapad+ma thabs shes nyi bla 'bar: du tra kro ti ti ra bo: rba pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la: ma sur+ya ma zo la:rna tsaṇ+ḍa maṇ+ḍa la: :: rang byung rgyu yi he ru ke: yi shes dbyings nas gdan la babs: mnyam sbyor bde ba chen po'i sgras: 'phags pa mchod cing /gzhan don byasaḥ yongs gyur 'bras bu'i he ru ma: che mchog badz+ra thod phreng rtsol: ma thing nag dbu gsum phyag drug pa: zhabs bzhi gyad kyi dor stabs tebagrad: rgyal 'gong bdud bzhi'i spyi nas brdzis: ga yas dkar dgod cing gshe ba'i zhalaḥ g.yon dmar yam gtsigs 'jigs par stonaḥ dbus mthing zurngam ba da khro bo'i zhal: sku mchog rigs lnga dbu la dzags : rdo rje'i thu khyang spyi bor lding: spyan dgu ljags 'grol na che ba gtsigs: g.ya sa kyi dang po rdo rje dang: bar pa kha ṭ+wāṃ tha ma me: g.yon gyi dang po bhad+dha dmar: bar pa thong gzhol tha ma na: lcags kyi sdigs pa mgo dgu bsnams: dur khrod 1

zhu: lngang: phyag gnyis rdo rje phur bu 'dril: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs dpa' gyi yum: shar lhor bla med he ru ku: mjing nag bya khyang zhing dbyug / tsho thogs: yum chen nyid zhi bde mchog ma: ma lnga spru sogs 'khor dang bcas: lho nub rig 'dzin rdo rje dkar: thod dbyug g.yas la dril bu g.yon:/ཿ/ spra bde chen rdo rje rnal 'byor yum: nub byang dregs pa kun 'du' mjing: tho ba g.yas mu mdung thung g.yon: kham sa gsum srid pa spyi 'dul yum: byang 0 6ze/ shar stobs ldan nag po che: lcags kyu g.yas la sbrul zhags g.yonaḥ 'byung ba lnga yi bdag mo yum: gzugs khams mkhar 'degs 'dod khams gnon:(1 kun kyang rigs bzhi'i 'khor dang bcas: zhabs kyis snye chen phyo mo brdzis: chos nyid mi 'gyur yum rnams mthing: gri gug thod 'dzin yab la 'khyad:// phyi rol sgo ba rigs bzhi ni: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril: tshom bu dgu yi dkyil 'khor la: bdun brgya nyer lnga'i lha tshogs kun: nyi mas 'od

zhi: cing: yo sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā kā ya badz+ra sa rna wa āt+pa konywa haṃ/ de bzhin du tham dang tsit+ta yang sbyar ro/ /yang spyi bo'i gnas so sor rigs lnga'i dbang tsho rgya bcas la/ oṃ ma hā shun+ya tā r+sā na badz+ra sa bhā wa mat+pa konywa haṃ/ de bzhin du/ oṃ ma hā a dar+sha/ oṃ ma hā sa / oṃ ma hā pra t+ya be dzi ṇa/ oṃ spra /ma hā kṛ khyu nuṣ+ṭha na rtswa na badz+ra sa rna wa āt+pa konywa ha/ spyi bo'i gnas lngar dbang lha yab yum rjes chags rgyas pa'i zhu bde'i chu rgyun byang chub sems kyi rol 62 pas dbang bskur/ nyon mongs pa lnga'i dri ma sbyangs/ phung po lnga rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas su banas gyur pas kun brtags la gzhan dbang gis rgyas btab/44 chu lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las/ gzhan dbang la yongs grub kyi rgyas thebs zhing ye shes 'gyur ba mid pa'i brdar dbu gtsug na rdo rje phyed pa dang / rigs ba bdag snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ rang gi 'dun pa sems pa dang / snying ga'i 'od kyi rol pa chen pos phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs ba

thams cad nam mkha' gang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor yor badz+ra sa mā jaḥ zhes snyan mnan la/ bcu gcig pa spyan 'dren pa ni: tshil chen dang sbyar spros bsreg cing rol mo'i sgra dang bcas: the: 'og min chos dbyings bde chen zhing khan sa nas: lhun grub rol pa yi shes klong dgu'i gar: zhe khro rab 'byams dbam chen bka' brgyad lha: gdug pa 'dul phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: ye h+ya haṃ dzaḥcu baṃ ho: sa ma ya lhang hreng dzaḥdzaḥ bcu gnyis pa bzhugs gsol ni: :: ma dag snang ba dag pa rab 'byams kyi: rten dang brten pa'i 'khor lor yongs shar ba: ting 'dzin sprul pa'i zhing mchog nyams dga' bar:dam ye gnyis mid ngo bor brtan bar bzhugs: sa ma ya rtsa spre sha ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: bcu gsum pa phyag 'tshal ba ni: :: rang byung rang zhar sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor 'a: bzang ngan gnyis 'dzin kun rtog rnam dag skrung: rang rig chos skur mjal ba'i brda phyag gar: spang blang med pa'i ngang nas btsal bar

ma mi ta dz+ra gad bla jo ho: nyer gsum pa sbyor sgrol gyi mchod pa ni: :: rdo rje pad+mo'i grong khyer 'a: snyoms par zhugs par rab bskul bas: lha tshogs —kun kyang mnyes gyur te: sdug bsngal bde ba chen por sbyor: rnam rtog bdag med dbyings su sgrol: dzaḥthe baṃ ho: ta na ga na tho dza ho: nyer bzhi pa bstod pa ni: the: mi sdug srin po'i sku ni sgeg cing dang 'a: drag shul rdo rje'i gad mo gshe ba'i sgra: mchog tu zhi ba'i thugs ni snying rje rngams: gar ghodagus sa gsum rnam gnon khyod la bstod: rdo rje thod khrag chags snang dbyings su sbyor: kha ṭ+wāṃ (dkur brten nas phrag par slong ba / thong gshol dug gsum/ tha sgorgod 'arjoms: mi dpung lcags sdig rnam rtog rgyal 'gong gshed: rtog med dregs pa 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod: chos sku 'gyur ba med pas sku mdog mthing: dbu ni sku gsum phyag ni par phyin drug: zhabs ni tshad med bzhi yi rang bzhin te: rtags dang yon tan rdzogs pa'i sku la bstod: chos nyid

skye: gcig la ye shes klong dgu'i tsal: gdul bya'i khams 'a rjes chags khro ba'i nyams: rol pa'i cho 'phrul mi bzad 'bar ba'i sku: bdun brgya nyer : lnga'i dbyil 'khor lha la bstod: nyi shu rtsa lnga dzab don la: bsnyen dang sgrub pa las sbyor ro: dang po zhi bar bsnyen pa ni: bdag nyid che mchog yab yum gyi: sta thugs mchog 'od kyi drwa ba'i klong: gsal stong zung 'jug nyi ba'i steng: kun bzang yab yum zhal sbyor la: rdo rje skyil krung mnyam gzhag can: thugs shitshuX kar bde gshegs kun gyi srog: yi ge 'bru gsum brtsegs mar gsal: de las 'od 'phros snang srid kun: ye shes lnga ru sangs rgyas bsam: 'khor 'das tshadzo ro gcig lta ba'i ngang: yo āḥs: rigs rnams kun gyi dbang phyug mchog: sangs rgyas kun gyi mes po sgom: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam yas kun: bde gshegs gcig sgrub kun gyi ngang: grangs kyi bsnyen pa bye ba gsum: tshe gcig byang chub 'dod pa rnams: 'di la rtag tu nan tan gyis: 'byung 'jug sngags su goms pa na: phung

sku: chen dkyil 'khor tshogs kyi bdag: bar du bshags pa mi bgyi rgyu: rna' 'byor ldan 'a dam tshig gnyan: tha ma bsgral stabs mi bgyi rgyu: rtogs tshu pas bdag rgyud sngon bsgral phyiraḥ da lta lhag mas mi mchod rgyu: ma tshogs dbang phyug ging laṅka: pho nya sum brgya drug cu sogs: kun kyang dpal chen ༷ sprul pa yin: lhag ma /ba chus mi bran rgyu: dam tshog gcig tu bsre ba'i phyir: 'bangs thog rje yis mi mnan rgyu: ci bcol las ma bskul ba'i phyir: nga 1 rje la 'bangs kyis mi rgo' rgyu: drag shul las thabs myur ba'i phyir: the rnam dag rang bzhin zhi ba las: bcom ldan dpa' chen sprul pa ni: thabs tsha62 shes zla gsang rol pa las: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong ba ste: khyed cag sngon gyi yal gam can: 'ag na glo snying nang khrol thogs: legs zhes stangs ba 'dzin tshogs khang nyul: mthu dang rdzu 'phrul dpag tu med: sngon tshe dpal chen he ru nas: dug gsum ru tra bsgral ba'i tshe: khas blangs dam bcas dran

sku: dag kun tu bzang po'i dus: mngon rdzogs ye shes dam pa'i 'og min du: kun gzhi yid chos dag pa'i ston pa yis: rang snang rang bzhin med rta pa'i 'khor tshogs la: rgyal ba dgongs brgyud rdzogs pa'i yo ga gsum: brda tshig brjod pa bral ba bstan pa'i tshe: grags chen gsal ba'i ston pa bcu lto gnyis dang: dga' rab dpa' bo gsang 'dzin rdo rje chos: brda rgyud rig 'dzin grub pa mchog rnams kyis: ston 'khor dgongs pa gcig pa'i dbang tho zlo thob bzhin: tshogs brgyad rang grol gtor ma 'di bzhes la: 'khrul pa gzhi la dag pa'i phrin las mdzod: de rjes gsang sdogs bstan pa byung ba'i tshe: mi/(tsho 'og min dga' ldan ri rab lhun po'i rtse: lha gnas gsum du grags pa'i gnas mchog dang: zham bha spru dang yo rgyan za hor yul: sen la dang snye ba gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rtse: mchod rten chen po bde byed brtsegs pa du: rig 'dzin sde snod mtha' dag babs pa'i tshe: 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das

ba'i mkha' 'gro dang: dkyi' 'khor mu ran skyong ba thams cad kyis: gtor ma len cing legs zhes stangs 'dzin pa'i: khas blangs dam bcas bzhin /du phrin las mdzodaḥ de rjes 'gro don dus la babang pa'i tshe: klu sgrub snying po pad+ma thod phreng sogs: grub pa'i rig 'dzin chen po brgyad rnams kyis:sgro 'dzam bu'i gling du dar zhing rgyas mdzad cing: khyad bar brag dmar dpal gyi mchims phu du: rig 'dzin slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi: lha sras rgyal de〉 po tshangs pa'i me tog la: sgrub pa bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor zhal phye zhing: seṅge rnam rol khas pu ri yi rtser: gnod sbyin thams cad dam 'a bzhag pa'i bye rtetshe: srog snying phul te chad tho bzung ba ltar: mchod gtor bzhes spru phrin las 'grub par ma dzod: de rjes tshos/sa bdun rol pa bal po'i yul : rang snang mchod rten thu rung kha shor duḥ rang byung rdo rje 'jigs rme da gling pa la: dbyings kyi rme kha' 'gro nam mkha' tre dzod kyi brda: ye shes lnga ldan sprul

6ཿ pa'i shog ser las: brag dmar bre gu brtsegs pa'i dge'u ru: kun tu bzang po dri med 'od ther gyis: bka' rgya lung rdzogs gtad rgya bkrol tsā ba'i tshe: spyan gcig khrag tu khol ba'i ma mo dang: bya rog gtsug phud 'dzin pa'i drang spyong gis: khas blangs tha tshig bzhin du phrin mas mdzod: bshal lto chu gtor mar bran la bstan ma skyong ba ni: bh+yo: tshogs dang bka' yi bdag nyid ni: khrag 'thung rdo rje nam mkha'i yum: gangs ri can gyi yul lha ni: sgorgyo bdud dang gnod sbyin sman mo bzhi: tshur spyon tshur spyon gtor ma yongs: rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis dang: dus sbyor bcu gnyis gnas dag pas: misnatsho bal bod mtshams na tshe ring ma: 'a stod rdo rje ga /'a ma skyong: gnod sbyin gangs la kun bzang mo: 'brog chen 'khor 'du' bgegs kyi gtso: sdo mo ba /gangs rar sbyan gcig ma: byang na mkha' lding klu mo rgyal: kha rag rdo rje khyung btsun ma: mi chen sprom rar drag mo rgyal: rkang btsun de mo bod khams /

skyong: 'brog btsan rdo rje sman gcig maḥ rjo mo nags rgyal g.yar mo bsem: dbus na rdo rje zu le sman: kun kyang pad+ma'i bka' nyan te: dam spru gnas skang rigs la 'go: tha tshig bzhin du gtor ma yongs: mtha' yi dmag dang gya 'dre'i 'tshubs: mu stegs 'gyu ba'i sgo 'grang dang: 'gong po /spun dgu'i nad da' srungs: rtag chad thar par 'khrul pa yi: 'jigs tshogs lta ba dbu mar bzlog: bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis gyi: bstan pa na dar ba'i phrin mas mdzod: yo la la: le le: ti ti: te te kha rag ma: ma ma sring 'gro ma traṃ rtso r+bha :: gtor gzhong ri rab tu bsams pakha sbub la: yugu: dam sri bya ba'i sdig can khyed: 'gro ba yongs gyi rgyud la rgol: byang chub sems gyi brtul zhugs bros: mnan no stong chen thog tu mnanaḥ gtad do chu srin gre bar gtad: bskyur ro gzhin rje'i kha ru bskyur: bsreg go ye shes me yis sreg: bdag tu lta ba ma zhig bar: bskal pa zhig kyang mi

kyang: rmongs dang ma rig nyon mongs pas: zil gyis non pa bdag cag ni: zhes pa du ma'i snod lags te: mgon po thugs rje che rnam sa gyi: zugs /la khro ba mi mnga' yang: legs zhes stangs 'dzin bdag po rnams: sbyon mthong tsam na chad pa gcod: 'gal zhing nongs pa ci mchis nga/: mthol lo bshags so tshangs par rgyol: yi ge brgya pa 2 na gsu / gyis snying nas bshags par bya'o: nyer bsdu ni: :: snod bcud lha dang bzhal yas su: shar ba dag she pa'i snod bcud kyang: rten nyid brten pa lha rnams kyang: gtso bo la khrim de yang the: zhabs kyu nas bzung nā da'i bar: rim yal gdod ma'i gshes chisu aḥ zhes mnyam par bzhag: spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor du ldang ba ni: slar yang rig pa byang chub sems: rjes thob gnyug ma'i he ru ku: skyeg rgya gcig pa'i gnas gsum du: yi ges mtshan pas rnam rtog spungs: badz+ra rak+ṣa the: zhes rdo rje'i go bgo zhing: yi ge brgya pas brtan par bya'o: de nas bsngo smon ni:

sa: ha na ha na ru lu ru lu ཿ rtse rgya: zhe sdang khrag 'thung rgyal po dang: bde bar sbyor dang sgrol ba'i yum: khro zhing rngams pa'i tshul bskyed bas:gdug pa ma lus sgrol bar byed: a dang phroṃ gis rang bzhin sbyar: yum gyis yab kyi lce gzhibs nas: yum gyis thugs shar ut+pal gtad: zhu ba glus ༷ bskul gdung ba'i sgras: the rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams: srid pa rdo rjer bsgrub mdzod cig: srid pa rdo rje phur pa'i lha: ye shes/ khro bro grub bhe‘ par mdzod: lha ra ṇa phaṭa brjod pas: rgyal ba mchod cing gzhan don byas: sa ha ra ṇa phroṃ brjod pas: phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams: tshab /yab yum sbyor ba'i mkha' ru zhugs: dgyes chags ngang 'a 'od du zhu: gong bu'i bdag nyid phroṃ du gyur: yongs gyur 'bras bu'i he ru na: dpal chen /rdo rje gzhon nu ni: snying rje rngam zhi'i ngang nyid las: sgog dpa' 'jigs su rung ba'i sku: rdzu 'phrul zhabs bzhi dor stabs bgrad: rnam par thar pa'i

dbu gsum gyis: skug mdzad bzhad gshe khro bo'i zhal: ba/yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing nag: spyan dmar smin ma sma ra ser: khro gnyer chu /yi rlabs bzhin 'khrugs: phyag drug g.yas gyi dang po yis: gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu dang: bar pa rdo rje rtse lnga bsnams : g.yon gyi dang po rme dpung dang:bar ma kha tai rtse gsum 'dzin: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur pa 'dri': na thing nag sku la dur khrod chas: rigs lnga thod pa lnga yis brgyan: 'khor yo dkyirgyas 'debs bde ba'i yum: zhal gcig phyag gnyis thod sbrul brgyan: dril bu thod khrag 'dzin pas 'khyad: e ka tsu ti sgrol ba'i yum : gro gug thod mo khrag khams gsum sgrol: res 'ga' kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum bsnams: g.yer ka dril bu nyid las kyang: rtog med chos gyi sgra 'byin cing: ma mo drug cu pho nyar 'gyed: lha las rdo rje zla dkyil yo: khri las pad 'dab nyi mar lta: sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya 6sla: rā ga yā ho: rā ga rā mi: brda dang

rlu: brda lan gyis bskul nasaḥ dzaḥ: bo ho'i phyag rgya bzhis: stong pa zhin tu yod med mas: chags pa lcags kyu rol pa zhagasaḥ tsum+bha sgrog la sgra grags dril: gnyis med byang chub sems kyi sgrin: dang por babs pa yum gyi mkha': gzhal rmed khang byung gnyis pa gdan gsum pa sa khrin nyid 0 du rdzogs: lhaḥ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku: ngang nyid rdo rje chos dbyings 'as: 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa'i: sku yi dbyig tu sras bskyed shi / cig: yo bu badz+ra rat+na pad+ma 1rmā shā 'a ya sarba khri ga nan bo r+bha phaṭaḥ sras mchog zhwa spru rigs lnga ni: stong nyid dbyings pos yongs skur shar: sprul tshapa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor du: yum gyis bla gar lhun gyis grub: badz+ra sa mā dza:sa bsang nas: rigs lnga stang dpya' bcu'i rang bzhin: thabs gyi thal /mo'i bar du byon: bde ba'i rlabs kyis dbang rnams rjogs: dbang rtags rigs lngas dbu 'a brgyan: stod ni gtso tho yab 'dra la: smad ni chu srin

phur bu'i dbal: lcags bsregs 'bar ba me stag 'phro: rgya mdud nang nas sngags sgra sgrogs: chu srin kha nas me lce dang: sdog sgrul thal lcang cho 'phrul 'gyed: stong gsum gdug pa'i klu rnams 'dul: thugs rkar dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs dang: dbu 'a rigs lnga'i khrag 'thung rdzogs: dgra snya g.yas la rang rtags g.yon: bar pa kha ṭ+wāṃ gtun zhing dang9 tha ma ri rab phur bu 'dril: rgyud lnga ye shes lnga ru sgrol: dug lnga rtsad nas gcod par byed: sangs rgyas 'dus pa thams cad kyi: sku gsung thugs su byin gyis rlobs: yi bu ṅgā ske shā la ya kā ya batha nan: tha la dz+wa la pra dz+wa la:phyi ṭa bru ṭa sarba na sa pa na ya lhu phaṭa: yo pad+ma shī phe shī la ya wāk+ka badz+ra nan: sarba da sge gri sho dha ya phaṭa: yo badz+ra shī bai shī la ya tsi rta badz+ra nan:tsha tshi r+bha phaṭa: ces byin gyis brlabs nas byug bdug brab gsum gyis gzi byin bskyed pa ni: yo badz+ra ṅgā li tī 'a ya ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la ni phroṃ phaṭa: lus kyi

zhiḥ bkrag dang ldan pa dngaḥ ba tha'i bu ga rdo rjes gtams : ma hā gu ta la pra ta spru lhu phaṭaḥ bu thams cad 'dus pa'i skur: khro bo du mas byin gyis rlobs: be ta wi maṇ+ḍal rak+ṣa rak+ṣa r+bha phaṭa: lus spyi ba spu'i bu ga kun: khro chung nyid kyis rab tu gtams: khams gsum gdug pa bsgral ba'i lta snyir: gdul bya'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭhaḥ zhes phur pa rdzas gyi dkyil 'khor dang dbyer med du bsam mo: de nas phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil ngazhe ba 'khor bskyed pa ni: gtso bro yab yum thugs ka nas: lcags kyu lta bu'i 'od zer gyis: phyogs skyong bkug nas stan du bting: sbyor ba'i lam nas sgo nga tshabacu: phyungs te sngags spyi sgra gdangs las: khro bcu phra thabs so sor gyur: yo badz+ra kro ta hūm̐ kā ra rgya: gardza phroṃ phaṭa: gardza hūm̐ phaṭaḥ steng phyogs nyi zla'i gdan steng du: khro bo rdo ri phroṃ mdzad ni: zhal gcig phyog gnyis mda' gzhu 'gengs: yum chen rdo rje sgra 'byin ma: sprul pa phag dang

thig bu'i mgo: yo badz+ra kro ta bī dza ya rgya: ha na lhu phaṭa: ha na lhu phaṭa: shar phyogs dri za'i gdan steng duḥ khro tho rdo rje rnam bar rgyal: thug na rtse gsum 'khor lo bsnams: yum chen rdo rje snyems ma dang: sprul pa stag dang bya rgod mgo: yo badz+ra kro ta bhā la daṇ+ḍa rgya: da ha lhu pha ṭa: da ha r+bha phaṭa: shar lho me lha'i gdan steng du: ni la daṇ+ḍa dbyug pa me: yum chen rdo rje sder mo dang: sprul pa g.yag dang bya rog mtho/: yo badz+ra kro ta ya yimān+ta ka lhu: ba tsa phroṃ phaṭa: pa tswa rgya phaṭa: sto phyogs gzhin rje'i gdan steng duḥ khro bo rdo rje gzhin rje'i gshed: phyag na thod dbyug dgra sta tshabasnams: yul chen dur khrod bdag mo dang: sprul pa sha ba 'ug pa'i mgo: yo badz+ra gro ta ār+ya a tswa la :: bhad+dha phroṃ phaṭa: bhad+dha su phaṭa: sto nub srin po'i gdan steng du: khro bo mi g.yo mgon po ni: phyag na ral gri zhags pa bsnams: yum chen rdo rje gtun khung ma: sprul pa gzig dang 'i

zhiḥ ta'i mgo: yo badz+ra kro/ ta h+ya gh+ri wa hrīḥ hu phu rgya phaṭaḥ hu lu phroṃ phaṭa: nub phyogs klu dbang gdan steng du: khro bo chen po rta mgrin rgyal:phyag na zhags pa spu gri bsnan sa: yum chen rdo rje gtum mo dang: sprul pa byi la pu shud mgo: yo badz+ra kro ta zhi pa ra tsista :: tiṣ+ṭha traṃ phaṭaḥ tiṣ+ṭha 65 lhu phaṭaḥ nub byang rlung lha 'i gdan snyed du: khro bo chen po gzhan mas rgyal: phyag na mda' dang rnga yab bsnams: yum chen rdo rje mda' snyem sa ma: lipa sprul pa sbyang ke khra yi mgoḥ i badz+ra kro ta rna mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa 'a rgya: tshirnya phroṃ phaṭa: tshirnya hūm̐ phaṭa: byang phyogs gnod sbyin gdan steng du: khro bro rdo rje tshapa bdud rtsi 'khril: phyag na dbyug to rgya grum bsnam sa: yum chen rdo rje rlung 'byin dang: sprul pa seng ge pha s+t+waṃ mgo: yo badz+ra kro ta tre pho kya be+e dza ya rgya:khri phroṃ phaṭa: brtso lhu phaṭa: byang shar 'byung po'i gdan steng du: khro bro rdo rje khams gsum rgyal: phyag na lcags kyu rin chen bsnams: yum chen

dkyil 'khor bsams nas ni: rdo sde pad+ma 'khor pho dag: rgya āḥyo gyis mtshan pa mas: thugs gsung sku yi rdo rjer bsgom: rdo rje'i phyag rgya gnas gsum du bzhag la: yo sab ta thā ga ta ma hā tsista badz+ra swa rna wa āt+pa konywa lha: de bzhin du wak+ka dngaḥ kā ya sbyar: dbang bskur ba ni: snying khar : las rin bo che'i gzhal med khang sgo gcig pa'i nang du ye shes sems dpa' rdo rje mi bskyod ba tshon gang ba gsa' ba'i sgo srung rta mgrin yab yul du gsam la: ye shes sems dpa'i 'od kyis dbang lha spyan drangs par bsams la: rgya thabs kyi spyod pas gzhan don du: byams dang snying rjes gang 'du' ba: sangs rgyas srin las rdzogs mdzad ba'i: dbang dang byin rlabs bdag rgyol cig: rigs lnga'i dbang rgya gnas so sor bzhag la: yo ma hā shu'i ta ca na badz+ra hwa dzo wa āt+pa ka nywa lha: de bzhis du shurgya ta'i mal du: ma dar+sha: sa ma taḥ pra t+ya bek+ṣa na: kṛ ta ma nuṣ+ṭha bcug: de nas khams gsum gyi srog la dbang bskur

zhiḥ ba ni: lhu phroṃ :: 'gro drug nyon mongs bcings pa rnams: lhu gis dug chen rab sbyangs te: ma ne su tro pre dur gyur: ri yi khaṃ las me rlung chus: 'gro ba rab sbyangs phroṃ du gyur: khams gsum thams cad rdo rje sems: til gyi gong bu lta bus gang: rta mgrin rgyal po ye shes la: bstims lta pas byang chub sems rgyas gyur: yab yum gnyis med sbyor ba'i sgrasaḥ ye shes khro bo spyan drang ngo: de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: rgya: srid pa phur bu sgrub pa cha dang: dbang dang dngos grub rtsol ba'i phyir: ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol: khro bo chen po gshegs nas kyang: rtags dang mtshan ma ston pa dang: treb rdo rje phur pa'i dngos grub stsol: thugs ri'i lcags kyus rgyud bskul zhing: byams pa'i zhigs pas sbyan 'dren no: lcags sgrog bka' yi pho ltas btab:bde gshegs dril bus dgyes pa bskyed: ye h+ye haṃ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka dṛ sh+ya ho: bzhugs gsol ni: rgya: thugs mchog gsal ba'i byin rlabs mas: zhe

phyo: nya mo: gdul bya'i don la khra thabs gzugs 'dzin cing: dregs ba'i tshogs rnams ma lus 'dul mdzad ba: phra men pho rnya'i tshogs 'a phyag 'tshal / (ba bstod: 'dzab dgongs ni: sgrub pa dang sgrub chen sogs la: : sge shā be+e shu phaṭaḥdzaḥs 'dzab khang dbye nas bdag mdun gyi rnam par gsal ba kun la 'gre zhing bsnyen ༵ pa ni: rgya thugs ka dpal gyi the'u'i dkyil 'bor nas: sgo gcig rin chen gzhal yas khang: bde stong dbyer med ngang nyid las: chos kyi sku las gu ba1 yongs skur shar: pad+ma zla ba'i gdan la bzhugasaḥ skyon gyis ma gos nu/ti mug sel: yab yum gnyis rme da zag med sku: sku mdog dkar gsal rnam tshoche dag dbyings: rdo rje dril bu thug na bsnams: des rab byang chub sems dang ldan: rtog med mi 'gyur skyin krung bzhugs : ma kha' dbyings bde chen sku la bstod mi ni dpal chen yab yin te: badz+ra shes rab yum yin mo: 'i ni ye shes khro bo maḥ li ni dbyings kyi khro mo yumaḥ 'i ni thabs kyi mche ba

gnas yul dur khrod mkha' spyod yongs kyi bdag /rdo rje phag mo 'o na shu ga rar/ /bcu drug dga' ba'i ngang nas gsol ba 'debs/ /bde stong gnyis 'dzin 4 bral bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyal kun skyed yum mkha' 'gro'i gsang gsum nas/ /gdan gsum yongs rdzogs dam pa rigs brgya'i lhar/ /dngos 'jin waṃ zhen bral ngang nas gson ba 'debs/ /lha tshogs ro gcig rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /ngo bro rang bzhin thugs rje bdag nyid rje/ /rtsa gsum myu gu tshwatsho mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer la/ /dad dam gong 'phel ngang nas gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs yid gcig tu 'dres par byin gyis rlobs/ /ngagro phan snying rje kun tsho tsho /khyab klong yangs nas/ /'jigs med phrin las 'od zer dpal 'bar la/ /dam tshog rgyud ldan ngang nas gso' ba 'debs /rab 'byams phrin las 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /brtul zhugs thabs shes 'du 'bral med klong nas/ /nye ru ka dpal ye shes rdo rje 'a/ /stem skyung med pa'i ngang nas gsol
