———— / phyo: mkha me 'gro bde chen rgyal ther 'dud: dkyil 'khore rme gam sgo ga she byebye the: chos ——byebyeng dmar po lha mtshan canas de — —steng bde skyong ma hā na: yang na rin chen sman bcud gtams: shel dang me long srog gi rten: phyi nang mchod pas mtha' nas bskor: nub kyi phyogs su kha bstan la: dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni: na mo: skye med ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sku:'gags med rang byung rnal 'byor ma: rgyal yum rdo rje phag mo la: 'du 'bra' med par skyabs su mchi: lan

6ཿ ba 'dumes sprul sku'i spyan(g.yas 'og)gyis khams gsum 'gugs: sku 'a rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor rjogs: thugs ka dpal gyi be'u'i dbyings: ma 42 bskyed rang byung yongs grub lha: 'khor yo rtsibab/ lnga'i lte ba du: kun gzhi yid chos gnas dag pa'i: khyab gdal rig pa kun tu bzang: snang stong ma gnyis med yum dang sbyor: rtsibs lngar gzugs tshor 'du shes dang: 'du byed rnam shes/ dag pa'i lha: rnam snang rin 'byung snang na tha' dngaḥ don r+ha'u grub rdo rje mi bskyod par: sa chu spyan dang mā ma ska: me rlung gos dkar dam tshig sgrolaḥ nam mkha' dbyings kyi dbang phyug lngar: gnas dag rigs niX sgo kyi yum lngas 'khril: g.yas phyogs dbang po'i rtsa bzhi la: rnam shes dag pa'i nang sems bzhir: yul can dag pa'i sems mas 'khril: mig la sa snying sgeg mo ma: rna bar thug rdor glu ma gnyis: sna la nam snying phreng ba mo: lce 'a sbyan ras gzigs gar ma: g.yon phyogs dbang po'i rtsa bzhi la:

zhiḥ gsung: dran pas bde stong ye shes bskyed pa'i thugs: rnga kri'i rje mo mkhar chen bza' la pastod: bcu drug dga' ster mchog gi pho nya mo'i:62 gsal snang sgru ma'i ting 'dzin dang 'grogs pas: phyi nang gzhan gsum rtsa rlung thig le'i kham sa: kun tu bzang mo'i grong du dag gyur cig: 'di ltar za bsgrub pa'i dzab dgongs niḥ rang nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka du: phag mo mjing nag gri thod can: snying dbus dga' 'khyil baṃ mtshan mthar: sngags ②4 phreng 'khor ba'i 'od zer gyis : lha sku'i snang zhen gsal bar byas: rig bdag bla ma'i thugs rgyud bskul: de mas 'od 'phros don gnyis byas: bla tshi/bra ma'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun: zag med bde ba chen por babs: dga' ba bzhi yi byed mas kyis: dbang bzhi'i ye shes nyams su skyong: yi pad+mo yo gi ni stso na wā rā haṃ sbri: zhes rtsa sngags dang: lus dkyil la dmigs nas: yo gya h+ya ca na tho rji tsit+ta ma hā su kha ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo suḥ rgyal thabs spyi

zhi: 'byor ma: mkha' 'gro dang rna mkha' 'gro ma: tshogs kyi 'du bar gshegs su gsol: dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldemaḥ lcang yo'i zar bu ta 62 4 la: snyan cha gdu bu kyi yi yiḥ rus rgyan g.yer kha khro pho yoḥ cang te'u dril bu'i sgra dang bcas: rdo rje'i glu dang gar 'a rol: 'dod yon yongs spyod tshogs su 'bulaḥ dam tshig nyams pa mthol yo bshags: phyi nang bar gcod dbyings su sgrol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: tshogs skong nga 4〉 sbrel mar byed na: ho: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti thug dbang gyur pas: lus ngag sems kyis sdig spyod khusgo mthol zhing bshags: theg pa dman pa'i dbang du gyur pas na: yang dag don ma rtogs pa mthon yo bshags: snying rje chung zhing zhe sdang dbang gyur pas: 'gro ba'i don ma bgyis pa mthol pho bshags: ye pho gnyid kyi dbang du gyur pa yis: sgom dang sgrub pa g.yel ba mthol zhing bshags: ser sna

sku: ba'i skyon dbang gis: chags skang 'khor bar skye ba mthol yo bzhags: bshags nas sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub 11la: zhes snying bag pa nas 62 bshags pas dam tshig nyams chag thams cad sor chud par 'gyur ro: de nas lhag ma ni kha phrus btab la: yo ma kā ro mu khaṃ sarba lha māṃ āt+ya nut+pa twa ta oṃ āḥrgya:phaṭa swā hā: sga: lhag pe dbang ba'i bka' nyan ni: mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis dang: ging chen khyo zhug la 'bum: pho nya sum brgya drug cu'i 0〉 sde: mgyogs ma bzhi dang 'bar ma brgyad: ma mo bdun dang sring mo bzhi: shugs 'gro gnas nyul phra men rnams: lhag la gdung zhing tshogs khang chipho 'grim: pham phabs bzang po 'di bzhes ma: mi mthun rkyen ngan bar chad sol: bcom pa'i grin las 'grub par mdzod: ces phyi rol du dor: thugs dam bskul ba ni: lha bzhengs sheg mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i lha: chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs la: byang chub bsgrub pa'i bar chad thul: snod bcud

ru: zab rgya: rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pas bags mda' mtsho rgyal bla mtshor: mkha' 'gro rang byung rgyal mo'i thugs ka nas: dpal len ba med pa'i mkha' 'gro'i brda ri spyan drangs pa las bsgyur ba zad nas chog khrigs su bsdebs pa'o: :

dgu ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs/ /rgyud sde bzhi drug yi dam gyi/ /dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang / /'og min mkha' spyod gnas dang yul/ /sa spyod la sogs zhing khams nas/ /bzhugs pa'i rme kha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang / /ye shes las grub thugs dam bskang / /lhan skyes zhing skyes sngags skyes pa'i/ /— gur khrod brgyad yul nyi shu dang / /gnas chen su ma cu rtsa bdun na/ /bzhugs pa'i mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang / /gnas dang nye gnas zhing dang nasna/ zhe/ /tshan rnyo nye tshan 'du nye 'du/ /dur khrod nye ba'i khrod gnas dang / /'thung spyod nye 'thung gnas yul na/ /bzhugs pa'i mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam tsobaskang / /snang srid yang dag mkha' 'gro'i gling / /phung khams mkha' 'gro bye ba'i grong / /gdan gsum yang dag dkyil 'khor lha/ /ro gcig chos sku'i klong du bskang / /zag med bdud rtsi'i rlangs pa las/ /yongs shar mchod rdzas kham sa gang ba/ /ba spu'i khyangs nas rab jim zhing / /dgyes tshim nyam sa

'dzin yum bka'i sgos bskang zhig /dgos ces bla ma pad+ma yis/ /nan tan bskul gnang ma ldog par/ /chos 'dir mos pa lam byed mkhan/ /ris bral yongs grags mkhas grub brnyes/ /dam pa du ma'i bka' 'bangs pa/ /tha shal 'jigs med gling pa yis/ /thol byung bris 'di yongs la dge/ //sarba man yaṃ// //h+phe
——— ——— —— ——— ———— — —— ————ske/ /rdo rje'i lha mo bcu drug gi mchod breng d+me za'i rgyud mangs zhes bya ba bzhugs/——/

rdo rje phreng ba ma yis mnyes gyur cig /gu ru sab ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ma le ā+oṃ pra chus hoḥ 'jam mnyen puṇ+ḍa ri ku'i lang tsho la/ /reg 'jam dbang po'i gzhu yi 'khri shang can/ /skad snyan 'gyur khyag stong gi glu len ma/ /rdo rje glu ma'i tshogs kyis mnyes gyur cig /gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri spre rdza ra badz+ra girti hrīḥpra tī ts+tsha hoḥ bung ba pad+ma'i tshal na g.yo ba bzhin/ /phyag zhabs gser g.yu'i gdu bus mdzes pa'i gar/ /mig 'phrul lta bur bsgyur sbya ba'i g.yo ldan ma/ /rdo rje gar ma'i tshogs kyis mnyes gyur cig /gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra shīrti maḥpra nyis hoḥ bcu drug 'ang tshos myos pa'i rnam 'gyur des/ /snying spru dga' ba'i ya mtshan cir yang ster/ /ju zhim thos phor thogs pa'i smin legs ma/ /rdo rje bdug thos ma yis mnyes gyur cig /gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri rtswa ra badz+ra cu pe r+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ tshangs dbang 'chi med bu mo'i 'arjo sgeg kyang / /zhin tu mdzes pa'i 'ang tshos brtan

bris pa'i gzugs/ /bzhin mdzes mji ra ba'i thod bcings can/ /rgyam po'i rnga las bde stong sgra 'byin rma / /rdo rje rnga skum ma yis mnyes gyur cig /gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra mṛ haṃ gi sgyuḥpra jirngo hoḥ rat+na'i sor gdub 'grol ba'i khya tshur gyis/ /dri za'i bu mor 'gran pa'i tam bu ra/ /gre na ba'i dpyid du sbreng pa'i yid 'phrog ma/ /rdo rje pi wang ma yis mnyes gyur cig /gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra snyi ni r+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ pha bye dga' ba bcu drug rlung gi rtar bskyon nas/ /jig ye bcu drug gnas su dag pa 'a sa/ /stong nyid bcu drug gling bu'i sgrar ston pa'i/ /rdo rje gling bu ma yis tshimanyes gyur cig /gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra waṃ se trī pra tīts+tsha ho: zla gzhon pad dkar lta bu lang tsho'i dbal/ /mig gi bdud rtsir sbyin dang chabs cig par/ /snyan 'gyur rdza rnga'i skad sgrogs na chung ma/ /rdo rje rdza rnga ma yis mnyes gyur cig /gya ru sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra

sa༅༅/ /mu rarme maḥpra tīts+tsha hoḥ stong nyid nam mkha'i rgyan gyur lha yi gos/ /rin thang brjod du med pa'i pañtsa yi/ /'phrul ldan sor rtses sgron pa'i tsho mdza' na mo / /rdo rje reg bya ma yis mnyes gyur cig /gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra parnye = pra 'i ho: chags med chugs pa chen po'i zur pa mig gis/ /dpa' bo'i yid la myos pa'i chos rkun 'jug: /'ag na ro brgya'i dpal 'dzin zhal zas thogs/ /rdo rje ro ma'i tshogs kyis mnyes gyur cig / sgrubachi ga ru sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ra sa hrīḥpra tīts+tsha hoḥ bde bas bde ba'i mthar son stong pa nyid/ /bde chen chos kyi 'byung gnas mngal rmatshi khur can/ /bde stong ngang las rgyal kun bskyed pa'i yum/ /chos spyi rdo rje ma yis mnyes gyur cig /gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra dharma ṅgārtu maḥpra tīts+tsha hoḥ de ltar shin tu med du byung ba rdo rje'i lha mo bcu drug la nang gsel kyis dbye na/ phyi sgeg bzhi/ nang sgeg bzhi/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las te gsang ba'i

pad skor gyis rjon bsus nas rang sngags dang phyag rgya bkun zhing / rdo rje be gol gtog / pas bsgol te nu ma g.yas g.yon gyi steng du 'jog pa'o/ /de lhar rdo rje'i rig ma bcu drug gi /mchod phreng dri za'i bu mos nga ba'i thu/ /rgyud mang stong gi 'gyur dang ldan ba 'di/ /ngag dbang dbyangs can lha mos bdag la byin// //

— //rnal 'byor nyid dbyings spa bsam las 'das pa'i/ /mnyam nyid byang chub sems 'a rtag tu 'dud/ /kun bzang rdzogs chen ye nas brda' ba la/ /phyi nang gsang ba bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /snang srid rnam dag lha dang lha mo'i dbyings/ /'byung dang 'byung gyur yab yum lhun rdzogs rnams/ /gsang la chen rab dgyes gzugs can bdag nyid ma/ /mkha' dbyings klong yangs pad+mo 'khyel pa la/ /gnyis med khrig le chen por 'od gsal zhing / /ma bcos be+e〉 spros med byang chub snying po'i sku/ /cir yang snang ba bde chen g.yung drung lha/ /'du 'bral med pa gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bdag nyid chen po tsu rigs lnga yab yum dang / /byang chub lcam dral khro bo khro mo'i tshogs/ /rdo rje lha mo'i tshogs rje tshogs kyi bdag /rigs lnga dpal chen khro rgyal yab yum bcu/ /gnas dang yul gyi phyag rgya sgo ma bzhi/ /ye shes sprul pa'i lha tshogs mang po dang / /ma ltar byams zhing sring ltar gdung la sogs/ /legs zhes
——— bde ba can —nu —kane te/rdo wa dpag bye/ myu / 'amabazhugs /— — —/ —— ——

zhing gi bkod pa ni/ /zhing khams chen po gser gyi sa gzhi'i dbus/ /'byung ba yongs rdzogs dwangs ma'i rin chen mtsho/ /yongs su rgyas pa'i dbus su go skyes pa yi/ /pad+ma'i sdong po khri 'phang gsum dang ldan/ /yal ga me tog 'bras bu'i phur gyi zhing / /chu bya sna tshogs theg gsum chos sgra sgrog /phan tshun traṃ chos spyi ros tshams gar stabs bsgyur/ /ya la 'dab re re'ang mchod pa'i lha mos brgyan/ /snyan pa'i glu dbyangs mjes pa'i gar gyis rnga chod/ /rig shitsā 'dzin du ma gser g.yu byu du yi/ /mdog mtshungs bung ba'i tshul bzung theg chen chos/ /bdo dang stobs kyi skal ldan rnams la sgrogs/ /rin chen ne'u tshatsho seng brag ri'i tshal gyis bskor/ /de dag rnams la drang srong rig 'dzin gnas/ /ma yengs bas ma gtan ting 'dzin ros gang ba'i/ /ye ces rgya mtsho lhun gyis grub par bzhugs/ /phyogs mtshams ma lus ye shes 'od kyi gur/ /rab mdzes mdangs bkra rim gsum rnam par gsal/ /steng phyogs nam mkha'i 'od

pa med pas kun nas nyams dga' zhing shin tu'ang blta na sdug pa/ 'byor ba rgyas pa/ bde ba pho legs pa lha dang mi 'ba' zhig pa las ngan song dang lha min med pa/ rin po che'i rigs kha dog sna tshogs las grub pa'i zhing ljon pa rtsa ba dang / yal ga dang / lo 'dab dang / me tog dang 'bras bu rnams gser dang / dadu' dang / be+e kur+ya dang / spug dang / mu tig dmar po dang / shel dang / rdo'i snying po ste rin po che sna bdun las byas shing shebalta na sdug ba dpag tshad stong dang drug brgya'i dpang dang ldan pa/ gser gyi drwa bas brgyan pa rnams rlung gis bskyod pa las/ snyan pa dang / ma thun pa tshadang / yid du 'ong ba'i sgra dbyangs chog mi shes zhing / dri bsung rgyas pa'i me tog gi mi 'greng bdun gyi srid du kun nas bkram pa rnams ni mnan na sor bzhis rnam zhing / bteg na de snyed kyis mtho ba/ gzhan yang lha'i me tog ut+pal dang / pad+ma dang / ku mud ta dang / pad+ma dkar po'i tshal yid

sgrib pa dang / ngan song dang / ngan 'gro spru sogs pa tshor ba sdug bsngal ba'i sgra tsam yang med par dgra bcom 'gog ba'i snyoms par zhugs pa lta bu'i bde tro ba dang ldan pas bde ba can zhes bya la/ de bzhin du gos dang / rgyan dang / skyed mos tshal dang / bar snang la 'byung ba'i gzhal med khang dang // rol mo'i bye brag dang / mchod rngos la sogs pa yongs su sbyad par bya ba'i 'dod ba'i yon tan rnam ba thams cad ba gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi gnas dang shi1 mtshungs par ldan zhing dwangs ma'i zas kyis tshams par 'gyur ba/ gza' dang / rgyu skar dang / nyin mtshan du gdags pa dang / khyem yongs su 'dzin tshabra ba'i 'du shes kyang med pa dus dang dus su thos chu'i sprin char mngon bar 'bab cing lha'i me tog dang / rin po che dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / bla re dang / rnga ma'i bsil g.yab la sogs pa nam mkha' la 'dzin cing / lha'i bu mo dag kyang rol mo'i sgra dbyangs dang bcas

rdul bral shan tu rnam par dag ba sku mdog pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po la nyi ma bye bas 'khyad pa'i gzi byin can/ /zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i po steng du lhung bzed kyis mtshan pa'i phyag gnyis mnyam par bzhag cing dar dmar ser gyi sham thabs/ sngon po'i bla gos/ dmar po'i snam sbyar can/ dbu'i tsho gtsug tor ltar mi mngon pa la sogs pa'i mtshan dpe'i rgyan ma tshang ba med pas brgyan pa'o/ /de'i g.yas su byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yophyo 'phags pa sbyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / ga yon du mthu chen thob gnyis gtso tho la zhal phyogs pas 'dug pa/ mtha' bskor du sangs rgyas kyi zhing co dze 'di dang / zhing gzhan nas 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang / rgyal ba'i ye shes chags pa med pa la rnam nur kyi blos bar du gcod ba dang ma yin pa'i khyad par las/ nyan thos 'gog pa'i chos can la sogs te pad+ma'i mngal la skyed mos tshal dang gzhal med khang du 'du shes shing

'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas dang / bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas mgon po 'od dpag tu med pa la bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis po dang / byang chub sems dba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba sbyan drangs bar gyur/ zhes snyan mnan la/ gsum pa spyan drang pa ni/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon traṃ gyur cing / /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'arjoms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir bocasdu gshegs su gsol/ /badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ bzhi pa bzhugs gsol ni/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal tshirwa bar ldan/ bdag gi mchod yon bzhes slad du/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /pad+ma ka ma wa ya sta/ /gyis gtso 'khor rnams la gdan 'bul nas bzhugs gsol bya/ /lnga pa mchod bstod la sogs pa spyod 'jug las/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang dam pa'i chos/ /dkon mchog dri ma med dang sangs rgyas

rnams kyis/ /bdag la brtser dgongs bdag gi 'di dag bzhes/ /rgyal dang de sras rnams la bdag gis ni/ /bdag gi lus 'di gtan tu dbul bar po bgyi/ /sems dpa' mchog rnam sa bdag ni yongs bzhes sheg /gus pas khyed spyi 'bangs su mchi bar bgyi/ /bdag ni khyed spyi yongs su bzung bas na/ // srid na mi 'jigs sems can phan par bgyi/ /sngon gyi sdig las yang dag 'da' bgyid cing / /sdig pa gzhan yang blan chad mi bgyid do/ /khrus kyi litsho sang pa shan tu dri zhim pa/ /shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba bstar/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan/ /mu tig 'od chags bla re bres pa tshirwa der/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la/ /rin chen bum pa mang po spros kyi chu/ /yid 'ong legs par bkang bar glu dang ni/ /rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol/ /de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ /gtsang la d+me rab bsgos pas sku phyi'o/ /de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i/ /

ba der/ /me tog yid 'ong sel ma dgram bar bya/ /gzhal med pho brang bstod dbyangs yid 'ong ldan/ rdo /mu tig rin chen rgyan 'phyang mdzes 'bar ba/ /spro dpag yas nam mkha'i rgyan gyur de dag kyang / /thugs rje'i rang bzhin can la dbul bar bgyi/ /rin chen gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu ba can/ /khor ṣ+yo yug rgyan gyi rnam pa yid 'ong ldan/ /dbyibs legs blta na sdug pa sgreng ba yang / /rtag tu thub dbang rnams la dbul bar bgyi/ /de las gzhan yang d+ngha sta mchod pa'i tshogs/ /rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan/ /sems can sdug bsngal sems byed pa'i/ /sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig /dam chos tshetsho dkon mchog thams cad dang / /mchod rten rnams dang sku gzugs pe/ /rin chen me tog la sogs char/ /rgyun mi chad par 'bab par shog /ji ltar 'jam dbyangs la sogs bas/ /rgyal ba rnams 'a mchod mdzad rnga / /de ltar bdag gis de bzhin gshegs/ /mgon po sras dang bcas rnams mchod/ /

spyan ras gzigs kyi snying rje dang / /nam mkha'i snying po'i thugs bskyed dang / /chos kyi dbyings spyi stobs rnams kyis/ /sems can rnam sa 'a phan 'dod bas/ /tshul khrims chu bro 'a brten nas/ /khrims 'chal rgyu 'bras dag par shog na maḥs mchu bu /ཿ sarba ta —ba ga ta ma wa yo ki te kā ru ṇa mā ya ra ra ra r+bha dza swā hā/ mthu chen thob pa'i nus stobs dang / /nam mkha'i snying po'i thugs bskyed dang / /chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/ /sems can rnams la phan 'dod pas/ /brjod pa'i chu bo la brten nas/ khong khro'i rgyu 'bras dag par 'og na maḥs na sta bud+dha māṃ s+dza = swā hā/ sgrib pa rnam sem byin rlabs dang / /nam mkha'i snying po 'i thugs bskyed dang / /chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/ /sems can rnams 'a phan 'dod pas/ /brtson 'grus chu tho spru brten nas/ /le yo'i rgyu 'bras dag par shog /na na ཿsa man+ta bu māṃ/ aṣ+ṭa sa twa hi ta ma spya ga ta tai haṃ raṃ raṃ sā hā/ /

dug bcom mo/ /'dod chags zhe rdong gti mug gsum/ /'di dag tshe 'das dug gsum ste/ /bcom ldan dam chos dug mi mnga'/ /dam chos bden spro pas du gabacom mo/ /'dod chagasazhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /'di dag tshe 'das dug gsum ste/ /bcom ldan dge 'dun dug mi ma nga'/ /dge k+ta 'dun bden pas dug bcom mo/ /bzhi pa 'byung bzhi'i dug sbyong ba ni/ so so'i steng du ku shas dbyung ba'i tshul du/ sa ni dug gi pha yin te/ /sa ni dug na sta na ma yang yin/ /bden pa'i bden tshig 'di brjod pas/ /dug gsum sa yi nang du song / /chu ni dug gi pha yin te/ /chu ni dug gi ma yang tshotsho yin/ /bden pa'i bden tshig 'di brjod pas/ /dug gsum chu yi nang du song / /me ni dug gi pha yin te/ /me ni dug gi ma yang yin/ /bden pa'i bden tshog 'di brjod pas/ /dug gsum me yi nang du song / /rlung ni dug gi pha yin te/ /rlung ni dug gi ma yang yin/ /bden

snang gis mnar ba/ gar 'gro'i gtad pa dang bral ba'i bar do'i sems can che ge mos gtso byas ba rnams la 'bul yo/ /bar do'i sdug bsngal dang bral nas po myur du bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par gyur cig /na mo bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang / /chos gyi dbyings 〉 kyi stobs rnams gyis/ /'ang gas pa rnams la mchod pa dang / /sems can rnams la phan gdags blad/ /don rnams gang dag bsan pa kun/ /de dag she1 thams cad ci rigs pa/ /thogs pa med par 'grub gyur cig /sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yo ngas tshodze su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la lnga las/ dang po bshags pa dang 'brel bar thugs rje bskul ba sna/ phyogs rnams kun na bzhugs pa yi/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi sras/ /thugs rje chen po mnga' rnams la/ /thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni/ /thog ma med ldan 'khor ba

pas/ /mdza' dang skyi mdza'i don gyis phyir/ /sdig pa rnam pa sna tshogs byas/ /mi mdza' rnams kyang med 'gyur zhing / /mdza' ba rnams kyang med par 'gyur/ /bdag kyang med par 'gyur ba ste/ /de bzhin thams cad med par 'gyur/ /rmi lam nyams su skyong ba bzhin/ /dngos ngo gang dang gang spyad ba/ /de de dran pa'i yul du 'gyur/ /'das pa thams cad mthong myi 'gyur/ /re zhig gson tshe 'di nyid 'a/ /mdza' dang mi mdza' du ma 'das/ /de shidag don du byas pa'i sdig /mi bzad gang yin mdun na gnas/ /de ltar bdag ni glo bur zhes/ /bdag gis rtogs par ma gyur pas/ /gti mug chags tshodang zhe sdang gis/ /sdig pa rnam pa du ma byas/ /nyin mtshan sdod sa yod med par/ /tshe 'di rtag tu god 'gyur zhing / /bsgon pa gud nas 'ong med na/ /bdag lta 'chi bar cis mi 'gyur/ /bdag ni mal na 'dug bzhin du/ /gnyen bshes kun gyis mtha' braskor kyang / /srog 'chad pa yi tshor ba snye

ba da dpag med pa/ /sku tshe dpag med dge 'dun dpag med pa/ /byang chub sems dpas bskor zhing mdzes gyur pa'i/ /sangs rgyas bsod nams phung 4 po mthong bar shog /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba dang / /pad+mo dam pa zhin tu mdzes las skyes/ /snang ba mtha' yas rgyal bas mngon sum 〉 du/ /lung bstan pa yang bdag gis der thob shog /gsum pa bsngo ba ni/ 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang / /byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa sa/sdu dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag pe/ /kun nas kun kyang bzang po red gyur cig /rnam snang mngon byang las/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cho ga cig /thams cad nad kyang med par shog /yang na de bzhin gshegs bsngags pa'i/ /'dod pa phun sum tshogs gyur cig /yang na sems can thams cad kyang / /re ba thams cad yongs rdzogs pa/ /sgrib pa med pa'i tshul gyis su/ /ma thogs par ni 'grub bar shog /dud 'gro gcig la gcig za ba'i/ /

sne/ /rgyal ba'i phrin las phyir/ /sdom pa'i kun spyod mtshangs pa yo ga ltar/ /bkrol bas sems can gan la sman gyar cig /ces pa'ang mdo khams pa 'jigs med phrin ༅ ༄ ༄ ༄las 'od zer gyis nan tan chen pos bskul ba'i ngor rang byung rdo rjes dpal ldan tshe ring smongs su sbyar ba'o// //=

mdun gyi nam mkhar nyi zla pad+ma seng ge rin po che la sogs pa'i khri la spyan drangs par bsam/ oṃ āḥlhaḥ lan gsumaḥ na moḥ bde gshegs snying pos 'gro ba yongs la khyab/ /sems ni rgya chen mchog tu rab bskyed cing / /'gro ba 'di dag ma lus sangs rgyas rgyu/ /'di na snod min sems can gang yang med/ /bzhengs zhig bzhengs zhig stobs bcu mnga' ba'i lha/ /dus las mi 'da' thugs rje'i dbang gis ni/ /sems can don la dgongs pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /yid 4kyis sprul zhing bzhan sa pa'i gnas 'di ru/ /rgyal ba 'khor bcas ma lus gshegs su gsol/ /ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sde tshodapung bcas mi zad 'dzoms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus yang dag mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang / /dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra gu ru snye wa ṭak+ki ni sarba sa rma ya dza/ 'jig rten las 'das pa dang ma 'das pa'i mgron rnams byon/ dbus su

ni ḍāk+ki ni bu ling ta khā gyi/ kurma ṭīk+ka ni ba ling ta khā haṃ/ sa ma ya ḍāk+ki ni ba ling ta khā haṃ/ bhi zha ḍāk+ki ni bā ling ta khā haṃ/ lo ka blo'i ni ba ling ta khā hi/ ha ri ni sa ra tsa sgyu ya tsit+ta hring hring dza dza ba sming ta kha kha khā haṃ kha haṃ/ dpal ldan rdo rje pag mo 'khor mkha' 'gro sde lngas bskor ba ye shes dang las la grub pa thams cad la 'bul lo/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ gsum pa ni srung ma dam can rgya mtsho spyi la phul bas dgyes par bsam/ oṃ ma hā kā 'a sha sa na spa mṛ ta ba ling ta khā haṃ/ oṃ ma ma drag rak+ṣa e ka tsa ṭi ba 'i nga ta khā gyi/oṃ rag mo khye kha me bha ming ta khā gyi/ oṃ ra hu la ba ying ta khā gyi/ oṃ rme du tse ba ming ta khā hi/ oṃ badz+ra sa chu ba ling ta kha kha khā haṃ khra haṃ/ dpal ldan mgon po ma hā ka la 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / khyad par du yang dpal ldan sngags kyi bdag mo/ gan pa srog sgrub nag po/ gza'i dge

cad 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ lnga pa ni 'byung po thams cad la phul bas mnyes par bsam zhing / oṃ ma ka ro sogs dang / mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po /'di nyid 'bor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'byung po kun tu rgyu zhing phan gnod byed pa thams cud dang / khyad par du'ang mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis/ging chen po bco brgyad/ ling ga'i bdag po mgrin bcu/ phro nya sum brgya drug cu/ mgyogs ma bzhi/ 'bar ma brgyad/ ma mo bdun/ sring mo bzhi la dz+wa sogs rnam 'byor pa'i re ba skong bar khas blangs pa gams dang / gzhan yang lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / zha za dang / grib gnon 'a/ dze sogs pa'i 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad pa 'bul pho/ rnal 'byor pa bdag nag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la rkyen phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa tham sa cad mi 'byung zhing chag che ba dang nyams nga ba thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ rnam dag chos nyid zhi ba las/ /thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa byung / /thabs
— zhi: klong chen snying gi jig me 'as: bka' srung ma mgon lcam dra' bzhugs:

rlu: zhe sdang sbrul gyi chun po 'a thod pa tshal bur brgyus pa'i dra ba dang dra phyed dpyangs paḥ 'dod snam la mchod pa'i lha mo rnams gar byed cing: byang // shar nas rim ba'i zur bzhir rdo rje dang : gnam lcags dang : dar zab dang : khrag gi rgyal mtshan chen po bzhi gnas pa'o: pho brang chen po de'i phyi rim thod pa lcags kyi grong khyer la gzhin rje dang ཿ bdud dang: srin po'i tshogs gnas zhing mtha' lcags ri nag pos bskor ba'i nang khongs su dur khe /khrod chen po brgyad la ro rnam pa sna tshogs bam pa dang : rul ba dang : skugs pa dang : stag dang gzig dang dom dang dred la so gas pa'i gcan gzan tshi / dang / /dur bya na dang: bzhad 'a sogs pa'i sha zan mang pos gang ba: dur skang dang : rgyob zhing dang : tsher ma can gyi nags 'dabs 'a gnod /sbyin dang : sha za dang : ro langs dang: phra me na dang: ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpag tu med pa mdor na dur khrod kyi chas ma tshang ba med pas /

'jigs bar byas pa'i mtha' me dpung dang rdo rje'i ra bas rgya yongs su ma chad pa de'i sto bar grin pos rnam pa bzhi lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas: thod mkhar gru gsum rgya khyen chos kyi dbyings dang ma nyam pa'i dbus su sna tshogs ro'i gdan la: dpal sngags kyi bdag mo nag mo khros ma'i rgyal mo: kun tu bzang ste mo'i sprul pa: 'khor 'das thams cad kyi bdag nyid chen mo la nyid las mi gzhan pa'i 'bor dkar mo'i tshogs dang : ser mo'i tshogs dngaḥ dmar ñtsa〉 mo'i tshogs dang: mthing nag 'a sogs pa grangs dang mthas mi gtugs pa: la la rme dzes pa'i cha byad can: 'a la khro zhing gtuca/ pa: 8 sga chags zhing tshibazhad pa 'a sogs: mdor na ye shes dang las spru grub pa'i ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnam 'gyur dang ming gis/ tha dad du grub pa'i rigs thams cad dang:rnyi 'bor pho rgyas 'debs ma'i sku'i sprul ba dam can ma mo bcu gnyis: gsung sprul mkha' 'gro chen mo lnga: phrin las gyi sprul pa bstan ma bcu gnyis: g.yas

rlu: lug nag gsob: skang gling thod rnga lhag sprod sogs: rten rdzas rnams kyis thugs dam bskang : bya nag lug nag khyi nag 'bri: mi khyi rta yi bam lha chen dang : mdos dang 'bras bu sna tshogs pa: bskang rdzas rnams kyis thugs dam bskang : rta dang g.yag nag gri snying gis: dpal ldan mgon po'i rmi thugs dam bskang: ra yi zha khrag gsur chen gyis: skyes bu chen po'i thugs dam bskang: zha khrag snying sna ru mtshon gyis: gza' bdud 'khor bcas byāthugs dam bskang : dkar mngar 'o chol rta bong shas: dur khrod bdag mo'i thugs dam bskang: mdor na snang srid snod bcud kun: dbang po drug gi tshi tswa spyod yul du: rang rang mthun pa'i dam rdzas kyis: sprul 'khor yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang: khyad par dus kyi tha ma la: srid pa'i bde sdug ma mos byed: 'byung ba lnga yang yum lnga'i klong : de phyir srid ba ma mor grags: dbyings 'a rnam rtog mi mnga' yang: rtsal las sku' par shar ba'i tshe:

zhi: khros ma 'a gsol 'o: ye ka tsa ṭi spun drug spru gsol 'o: de'i bran mo bcu bzhi 'a gsol 'o: g.yog mo lnga bcu rtsa brgyad la gsol 'o: yang g.yog 'bum khri 'bum stong po gsol lo: nam gru rem ti 'a gsol yo: 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma la gsol yo: tha na ma bzhi la gsom lo: sa (tshe bdag ma bzhi 'a gsol phoḥ bdag nyid ma bzhi 'a gsol pho: dur khrod bdag mo lcam dral spru gsol pho: dbang gi lha mo tsatri ka 'a gsol 'o: zhan pa nag ②sgo mo srog sgrub ma la gsol lo: lha mo dud sol ma la gsol 'o: rdo rje drag mo rgyal 'a gsol 'o: ma sring brtan ma bcu gnyis 'a sogs sprul pa yang sprul snying tsha〉 sprul rnams la gsol 'o: 'bul 'o: mchod do: gsang sngags kyi bston pa srungs shag: rnal 'byor pa'i mgon skyabs mdzod cig: bston 'dzin gyi skyes bu spel cig: dgra byung na snying thon cigaḥ gegs byung na mgo rgo khos zhig: dug byung na bya thong zhig: byad byung na rang gshed du thob cig: rkyen ngan dang

bar chad sol: bsam don gyi re ba gang yin pa skad cig nyid 'a grub bar mdzod cig: ho: rtogs pas bdag bsgral kun tu bzang po: dug gsum ru tra'i gshed du khros ba lha chen dpal 'bar ma ning nag spro 'a gsol yo: stag zhon sku'i mgon po la gsol yoḥ khring dmar gsung gi mgon po la gsol 'o: gri sgro gug thugs kyi mgon po 'a gsol 'o: legs ldan yon tan gyi mgon po spru gsol 'o: trag shad phrin mas kyi mgon po 'a gsol 'o: 'bul pho/ mchod do/ shi/ gsang sngags kyi bston pa spungs shig: rnam 'byor pa'i mgon skyabs mdzod cig: bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu them cig: dgra byung na snying thon cig: gigs tshi byung na mgo bo khos shag: dug byung na bya thong zhig: byad byung na rang gshed du phob cig: rkyen ngan dang bar chad sol: bsam don gyi re ba gang yin pa skad cig nyid la grub par mdzod cig: ho: gtsang ris lha yi mgon po dbang po dang tshangs pa 'a gsol 'o: dbang phyug dang khyab 'jug la gsol

/rlu: 'o: gdong drug dang 'dod dbang 'a gsol yo: tshogs bdag dang dh+ra gi 'a gsol 'o: klu'i mgon po mtha' yas dang 'dzog spro spru gsol 'o: dung skyong dang stobs rgyu la gsol 'o: pad+ma dang pad+ma chen po 'a gsol 'o: rigs ldan dang nor rgyas spru gsol 'o: drang srong gi mgon spro nyi ma dang zla tsha ba la gsol lo: mig dmar dang lhag pa pe gso' yo: phur bu dang pa sangs 'a gsol 'o: then pa dang sgra gcan spru gsol 'o: khyad bar du yang khyab sgomo 'jug chen po: khri nu rā tsa: rā hu la: ji ṭi pa treḥ ljang sngon drag po: du ba mjug ring: bdud bro rog ti: khri na ya ka la sogs te thog chispra ser dang ltas ngan gyi bdag po sprul pa'i gza' brgyad gdong mo bzhi dang bcas pa spru gsol 'o : 'bu' yo: mchod do: gsang sngags kyi bstan pa srungs sheg: rnam 'byor ba'i mgon skyabs mdzod cig: bston 'dzin gyi skyes bu spel cig: dgra byung na snying thon cig: gigs byung na mgo bo khos shig:

rlu: byad byung na rang gshed du phob cig: rkyen ngan dang bar chad sol: bsam don gyi re ba gang yin pa skad cig nyid la grub bar mdzod cig: ho: phyogs mtshams skyongs ba'i mgon po dbang po dang me lha la gsol 'o: gzhin rje dang srin po la gsol 'o: chu lha dang rlung lha la gsol 'o: gnod sbyin dang mo dbang ldan pe gsol lo: tshangs pa dang gza' skar ma gso' 'o: sa'i lha mo dang sa 'dzin lag pa chen po 'a gsol spro: khyad par du yang 'jig rten skyong rmu4 ba'i mgon po chen po yul 'khor srung la gsol 'o: 'phags skyes po pe gsol 'o: mig me bzang la gsol 'o: rnam thos sras spru gsol 'o: gzhan yang chirtsa 'jigs byed chen po dgu la sogs te dam tsheg shes pa dang dkar phyogs skyong ba'i tshogs thams cad la gsol 'o: 'bul lo: mchod do: gsang sngags spyi bstan ba srungs shag: rnal 'byor pa'i mgon skyabs mdzod cig: bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu spel cig: dgra byung na snying thon cig: gigs byung na mgo tho khos

shag: dug byung na bya thong zhig: byad byung na rang gshed du phob cig: rkyen ngan dang bar chad sol: bsam don gyi re ba gang yin pa skad cig nyid la grub bar marjod cis: ho: rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' nyan chen po sgro' ging rdo rje legs pa 'a gsol lo: rnal 'byor yongs kyi srung ma chen po la gsol lo: dpa' 47 bo yongs kyi dgra lha chen po la gso/smu yoḥ tshong pa yongs kyi ded dpon chen po la gsol 'o: brten na snying nye ba la gsol 'o: bad na mthu che ba la gsol ge / k+ta 'o: bskul na 'as myur ba la gsol yo: sprul 'khor dang bka' nyan phud dang gtor ma la gdung ba thams cad la gso' 'o: 'bu' 'o: mchod do: ne/ r+bha chisngags kyi bstan ba srungs skag: rnal 'byor pa'i mgon skyabs mdzod cig: bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu them cig: dgra byung na snying thon cig: gigs byung snye na mgo bo khos zhigaḥ dug byung na bya thong zhig: byad byung na rang gshed du phob cig: rkyen ngan dang bar chad sol: bsam don gyi re ba gang yin pa

rlu: skad cig nyid la grub par mdzod cigaḥ de ltar srid pa ma mo'i dkyil 'khor du ye shes dang las 'a grub pa'i spung ma thugs dam can: gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga dang bcas pa khyed rnams ston pa'i zhal mthongaḥ bstan pa dang dam tshig la gusaḥ mthu dang rdzu 'phrul gyi bdag po srid zhi'i khams na che btsun 'gran zla dang bral ba: mnga' 'og dang sde ris su ma 'dus pa gang yang med pas: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa sru ngas: dkon mchog gi r+hadabu 'phang bstod: rnal 'byor pa bdag cag la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa: gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa: drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa: sbyor tshib tsub mo 'a mos pa'i 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa de dag thams cad zhi ba'i phrin mas kyis dul bar mdzod cig: rgyas pa'i phrin las kyis spa bkongs zhig:dbang gi phrin las kyis snang ba sgyur cig: drag po'i phrin las kyis tshar chod cig: bdag dang 'jig rten thams cad la legs pa'i yon tan gong nas

rlu: bdag po: rnam 'gyur sprul pa cir yang ston: rdzu 'phrul bdag po khyod la bstod: res 'ga' mgar nag khros pa'i gdong: than dang ltas ngan /yongs kyi bdag: res 'ga' gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshul: dngos grub bdag spro khyod 'a bstod: khyad bar gtsug 'ag khang srung zhing: dam nyams srog la /hur thum dang : gri rgod 'thebs pa'i drag shul can: gsang ba'i sgrol ging gnyis la bstod: mdor na ma mgon lcam dral gyi: bka' dang 'khor na (riganas pa yi: legs nyes stangs 'dzin 'jig rten gyi: bdag po kun ma rab tu bstod: phrin las bcol ba ni: bh+yo: sum cu rtsa gsum lha yul na: skye chirgyud bdag po yab yum gnyis: ma na jal yid kyis sbyor ba las: dpral bar lcags kyi rmen pa sharaḥ yum gyis dmod pa stobs btsan pas : nag mo khros ma ra' gcig ma: bcu bdun rgyud kyi bka' srung du: gsang ba'i bdag pos dbang yang bskur: bdag med kun tu bzang mo'i klong : bdag

glu: bgegs: gang yin khyed kyi zas skal du: gtad do mngon spyod phrin las mdzod: chos srid bstan pa'i phrin las rnams: sde bzhi'i dpal gyis mngon mtho zhing: glo bur 'as bcol ba rlung kun: bzhes 'a bsam don lhun grub mdzod: ces brjod phud gtor gtsang sar gshegs:hrisnye

lhun po'i tho dang nyi zla'i bkrag mdangs kyang / /rngam ba da yon tan 'bar ba'i dpyid du spungs/ /snyigs ma lnga yi yang mthar lhung ba rnams/ /nad mtshon dmag 'khrug mu gis mnar ba'i tshe/ /skyabs 'os dkon mchog rin chen rnam pa gsum/ /dam can chos srung rgya mtshor bzhengs la 'bod/ /zhi ba ste phyogs gcig sku ngan mi 'da' ba/ /slob pa lam gyi dam bca'i mthar thug phyir/ /stong nyid dbyings las snying rje'i sgyu thabs gar/ /rnam bzhi'i phrin las ske〉 rol mor mnga' gsol pho/ /rta gdong me lce 'bar ba'i mu khyad nang / /las dbang bsod nams rlung rta dar drags pa'i/ /dpung tshogs yan lag bzhi tshoba'i rtsibs rnon gyis/ /gzhan sde'i brtan pa 'phrog par mnga' gsol lo/ /kun 'byung 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras rnam rtog gi /gzhan dbang nyid du yong yer /ma gzung yang / /gang la gsol ba btab na yid bzhin don/ /'bad med 'grub pa'i nor bur mnga' gson yo/ /rang sde srung la zhin tu na jangs bzhin

dmag dpon chen por mdzod/ /khyad par rang srid 'byor pas mi ngoms par/ /gzhan sde bza' ba'i lha min 'jug pa can/ /byed pa rgyu mthun mtshon /cha'i rno dbal rtser/ /rang srog rang gis 'phrog par mnga' gsol yo/ /gang po srung skyob byed pa'i lha srung dang / /mdza' gcugs dam bca' ri mo nyer bsubs la/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde bzhig pa'i mdun gros dpung di /nang dbyen dme 'khrugs sbyor bas spa bkongs zhig /rigs gsum rnga gon po mes —dbon rnam gsum gyis/ /rgyal bstan gangs rir drangs pa chud gsan nas/ /dge bcu'i khrims kyi mu khyad bzhig pa rnams/ /don snying skog mar 'byin 'a tsomanga' gsol yo/ /'jig rten las kyis sprul pa'i gzhan dbang la/ /sgyu dang dbang phyug rang dbang yin ther na/ /bden pa gnyis dang de yi bstan srung mu/ /bsnyen goms byas pa'i 'bras bu yal 'am ཿ/ /chos kyi sku ni dus gsum skye 'gag med/ /yongs spyod rdzogs 'as rnam sprul chos skyo nga rnams/ /

na tshems gcig dgra bo'i srog gcod ma/ /tsista 'di gsol dam nyams srog pe rngams/ /sha khrag yongs spyod dmar gtor 'di bzhes la/ /dam tshig dbang gis dam nyams gshed ma mdzod/ /ma mo srog la 'gyed phyir 'di gso' 'a/ /bdag gis bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /dam sdug dus 'a bab po sa ma yaḥ bla ma yang stag las so/ shilngu
——zhi:tho bka' byebye ma mgon lcam dra' 'bye ཿ ma mo mkha' —byebye'i 'khrugs skong bzhugasaḥ /

snyiḥ san drug dngaḥ bran mo bcu bzhi yang g.yog 'bum: 'dod khams bdag mo re ma ti: ming brgya ma spru mtshan stong ma: sna tshogs gzugs dang ཿ rdzu 'phrul can: stong khams khyab par sprul nas kyang: 'byung ba g.yo dang 'khrug byed cing: dus bzhi'i drod 'dzin bcud kyang 'phrog: nad dang rims //nywa spyi bdag mo mdzad: dben gnas hu' zhing tshogs khang 'grim ཿ rnal 'byor can la dngos grub ster: dam tshig nyams 'a chad pa gcod: legs nyes bhe'o/ stangs 'dzin 'jig rten skyong: kun la phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul: tshogs kyi 'khor los nyams chag bzhags: mdos dang mdangs kyis thugs dam tshisdu bskangs: mi nad phyugs nad bcad du gsol: zhing spru sad ser badza' than dang: mu sga 'khrugs rtsod med par mdzod: bh+yo: ma mo 'khrul/sa pa'i rgyu ba bstan pa: dam pa'i rdo rje slob dpon la: ma dad 'og par rtog pa bshags: dbang bskur zab mo thob byas nasaḥ bsnyen sgrub phyag rgya g.yel ba

bzhags: dam tsheg gcig pa'i spun grogs la: gshe skur khros dang 'khon pa bshags: sems can pha ma'i rang bzhin la: ngan sems gnod pa byas pa bshags: sngags kyi lta spyod gsang sgrogs dang: dam rdzas spang len bgyis pa bzhags: bud med shes rab rang bzhin la: brnyas dang log lta bgyis pa ca7 bshags: snang srid lha dang lha mo la: dgra gnyen phyogs ris phye ba bshags: lta ba sgom gyi la ma sgros: tha mal 'og 'gyur song ba bzhags: spyod pa litsho kun tu bzang po la: kha na ma tho phog pa bshags: bh+yo: khyad par ma mo 'khrugs ba las: 'jig rten mi bde 'byung ba'i rgyu: dge 'dun sde bra'akhrugs hor las byed: khyem pa sun 'byin bshas ra 'grim: sngags pa dam med mthu gtad byed: bskyed rdzogs gdeng bra' thog chos 'tshong: skye bo mna' za dug sbyor gshom: dge 'dun khrims nyams pha ma bslu: btu jag sdon pa'i mas kyis 'tsho: phan tshun 'thab cing ma rabs spyod: ming sring

tsham par mdzod la nyams chag bzhanarme / ——/rab 'byams grin las gang bco' 'grub pa dang / /'phral phugs yongs dge sangs rgyas 'grub pare shog /ces pa 'di'ang pad+ma chos 'phel ngor/ rdo blas smras pa yongs su dge bar gyur cig man lo// // sta hri —

po mchog khyod byin rlabs kyis/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa 'a/ /yongs spyod rnam gnyis rdzogs bar smon/ /bdag cag byang chub mchog thob nas/ /khyod dang mi 'bram 'grogs par shog /ces pa'ang grwa tshang gi rgyun 'don stabs bde zhig dgos zhes mdzod pa 'od zer gzhan phan gyis bskul ngor rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pas so/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /

ce dzhatsha

/po/ thod kyi a jo chen po/ mgar ba nag po/ mon pa nag po/ ga'u nag po/ ser skya nag po/ mched 'khor sum brgya drug cu'i gtso bo/ skye bo yongs kyi dgra lha/ ban bon yongs kyi srung na / dmag dpon chen po/ jag dpon chen po/ tshong dpon chen po/ stong dpon chen spro/ mkhan dpon zhe chen po/ gral dpon chen po/ las mkhan chen po/ sgrol ging chen po/ phro nya yang sprul phyag brnyan dang bcas pa la gsol lo/ 'bul yo/ mchod do// legs pa chos sheg /zhes pa sgrog cig /bsam pa sgrubs zhig /re ba skongs shig /mi la na tsha ma btang / phyugs 'a god kha ma btang / kha skya dang gleng brjod ma btang / mi kha dang da' yams ma btang / dgra rkun dang 'tshe ba ma btang / gzhan ya nga gzhi spru 'dug na legs par srungs shag /byes su 'gro na mgon 8bas mdzod cig /lam 'phrang 'jigs bar skye' bsu gyis zhig /chu 'a 'gro na sgrol 'don mdzod cig /tshong 'a 'gro na tshong dpon

zhe༄/ /gyis shig /dmag la 'gro na dmag dpon gyis shig /jag 'a 'gro na jag dpon gyis shag /dgra dang rtsod na pha rol non cig /mi mnyam rwa pa dang mnyam du chug cig /mnyam gnyis gong du legs par thon cig /bco' pa'i phrin las sgrubs zhig /sgrub pa'i rtags phyungs shag /dgyes pa'i sbya na' ston cig /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul bskyed cig /mnga' thang dang 'byor pa spel cig /snyan pa dang grags pa sgrogs sheg /bkra shas dang bde legs phun —ma sam tshogs par mdzong cig /ces pa'ang dam can stes ba chen po rngo rje legs pa la 'phrin bcol ting nga bsdas pa 'di ni kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang po klong chen pa rab 'byams dzā go ga / / cu zhu ༄ ga cu —rtsa bzang po'i gsungs byin rlabs can gzhan bcos kyis ma bslad par dag pa'o

mtsho ltar bskyil: sman gtor rak+ta phye mar sbos: skyed tshal zas gos dkor nor rdzas: zha rkyang ma he 'dod 'dzo'i ba: rdzu 'phrul zhugs ldan dre'u sngo:rlung gi rtsal ldan tsung shes rta: thos spyi glang po 'brong g.yag zhol: sna tshogs dar gyi 'phur lding g.yo: rnga ma'i lding gur 'ja' ris 'khyil: /rma bya sgros sgyu gar bsgyur ba dang: bya nag mchu ser 'a sogs pa: mdor na sman mo mnyes pa'i rdzas: ma tshang med pa mchod pa'i sprin: mig 'phrul lta bu'i ting 'dzin ⑩〉 gyis: nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor lor 'bul: dpal ldan lha mo'i thugs dam bskang: rdo rje bdud mo'i thugs dam bskang: / tshe ring mched lnga'i thugs bodam bskang: sprul pa yang sprul thugs dam bskang: thugs dam bskangs la nyams chag sol: bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod kyi: lta ba phog na /dbyings su gso: sgom pa yengs na rig pas skyong: spyod pa nor na tshogs kyis bskang: srog 'a bdud du ma 'beb cig: snying la rlung du ma 'jug cig:

zhiḥ dbyings spyi rje mo ma g.yel cig: 'khor gyi rnam rtog ma 'khrul cig: khyod ni 'khor 'das kun gyi bdag: dga' na gdod ma'i sangs rgyas ston:rdo khros na gza' skar thang la 'bebs: snod bcud 'byung ba'i byed pa mo: dus bzhi kun gyi drod kyang 'dzin: bka' gsang gnyan po'i bya ra mdzad: mazu ༷ rtsal can la bdag bstod doḥ rgya' dbang pad+ma thod phreng dang: rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i spyan snga duḥ bstan ba bsrung bar khas blangs bzhin: theg mchog ②bye rdzogs pa chen po dang : khyad par 'od gsal snying jig 'di'i: bstan pa yar ngo'i zla ltar spel: bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe dang : mdzad grin nam dzā byi mkha'i pha mthar brdol: brgyud 'dzin slob ma bu bzhin skyongs: bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang bskyed: gangs can bod kyi rgyal khams sa: nad kha chod la dal kha sbos: dgra kha bsgyur 'a mtshon rtse thul: char chu dus phob btsa' than sogs: mi mthun dus kyi rgyad ba sol: mdor na yid la gang /

'dzin byed/ /de las byung ba'i phywa g.yang dang / /dngos grub thams cad 'dir khug cig /mdor na lha klu mi'i nor bu/ /gling bzhi ri rab rgya mtsho'i bcud/ /sa rdo ri brag sdod bcud dang / /lha dbang klu dbang rgyal po'i mdzod/ /nyi gli gza' skar go la'i gnas/ /lha dang drang srong mngon shes — 344/ /bskal par gnas pa'i phywa dang g.yang / /ma lus lus ba med ba kun/ /rten 'brel rdzas kyi nus pa yis/ /deng gi rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'di'i/ / nga ze bsod nams tshe dpal yongs spyod la/ /nyi zla bzhin du kyi le yi/ /'ongs spyod bzhin du me re re/ /chu klung bzhin du 'du ru ru/ /'dres zhing brtan stseba'i g.yang khyag cig (g.yang 'gugs kyi 'don cha) mthu rtsal can la bdag bstod do/ /ces pa'i mtshams su sbyar ro// //

rgyas par mnga' gsol yo/ /de 'og la phyi gangs dang chu bar du/ /grub brgya'i gtsug rgyan bzhad pa rdo rje yi/ /rlungs sems chu tir drangs pa'i mdza' na mo / /zab lam jo nya'i dbang mor mnga' gsol yo/ /deng dus rtsod ldan snyigs ma'i yang rme tha' 'dir/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag 'jigs med gling 2 pa yi/ /bstan pa mtha' dbus yongs kyi la thod du/ /bcings pa'i gnyer kha 'dzin par mnga' gsol lo/ /rjes su chags pa'i mtshar sdug m+bha ma'i she tsho 'phrul/ /skye dgu'i snying 'a zhugs dang chabs cig par/ /mos pa rnam bzhi khab len rdos bsdus bzhin/ /pha rol brtan pa 'phrog par mnga' gsol yo/ / s+t+ra zhu bde'i zhing rtas drangs pa'i dwangs ma'i rlung / /rnam par mi rtog ma wa sgru ti'i grong / /rnam kun mchog ldan 'phro med rdo rje'i gzhir/ /sbyor ba'i bde chen dbang mor mnga' gsol pho/ /ye gsang ye klong chos nyid dwangs ma'i mkha'/ /rnam par thar pa gsum gyi dbyings chen por/ /sbyor tshe don gyi ye shes

/ pa 'bul ba ni/ : ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya yis/ /snang srid snod bcud ma lus nga 'i/ /mkho dgu'i 'byor tshogs ji snyed kun/ /ye shes bdud /rtsir 'char bas bskang / /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod spyi/ /'gal 'khrul nongs pa dbyings su bskang / /mthun rkyen tshe dpal stobs nus bskyed/ / // ste: bde stong rang byung mngon gyur rtsol/ /oṃ badz+ra pra mo ha ba ming ta kha kha khā gyi khra haṃ/ /zhes lan lnga'am bdun gyis gtor ma 'bul bstod pa dang phrin las bcol tshwa/ tsho ba ni/ phroṃ/ rdo rje g.yu sgron shan tu mdzes pa'i sku/ /dkar gsal gangs ri'i ngos ma nyi shar 'dra/ ///sgrub pa po 'a dngos grub mchog rtsol ba'i /mched stasnyi/ lnga 'khor dang bcas spru phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sdon tshe slob dpon pad+ma'i sbyan snga ru/ /ji ltar zha' bzhes zugs dam dran mdzod 'a/ /rnam 'byor bdag / 'a dgyes pa'i zhal bzang ston/ /bcol ba'i phrin las myur du 'grub par mdzod/ /mkhyen brtse'i lhas so/ /dge'o/ /bkra shis so/ / /

sgrub thugs dam bskang ba'i mchod pa'i rdzas/ /spyan gzigs dkor nor mkho dgu'i bye brag kun/ /nam mkha' marjod kyi yongs spyod ltar sprul nas/ /gsang sngags bstan skyong rnal 'byor re bskong ma/ /rdo rje gshog rgod 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /thugs dam dgyes skong nyams chags 'gal 'khrul bshags/tshi gang bcol phrin las thogs med myur 'grub mdzod/ rtsa sngags mthar/ sarba pañtsa rami bha rlung ta kha kha khā haṃ khā hiḥ lan lnga'am bdun brjod nas/ rgya sku litsho gsum zhing na gang la gang 'dul gyi/ /gsang gsum cho 'phrul dpag yas rol ba'i gar/ /dpa' ldan rdo rje gshog rgod sprul 'khor bcas/ /mnga' gsol sgobastod do rnam bzhi'i grin las sgrub/ /bde stong zag med rtogs pa mngon gyur zhing / /yid pe 'dod pa'i bsam don kun grub mdzod/ /bstan skyong rdo rje gshog rgod ma'i/ gsol mchod phrin las myur 'grub 'di/ /grub dbang bla ma'i rdo rje'i gsung / /sor bzhag kha bskangs dz+nyā nas so/ /

gzhin rje'i lcam/ /'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ /dpal ldan nag mo re ma ti/ /chibs su dre'u rta rkang gsum chibs/ /g.yas ba dug gi phur pa gdengs / /g.yon pa bdud kyi khram bam bsnams/ /dpa' ldan nag mo re ma du/ /chibs su bya rgyal khyung 'a chibs/ /g.yas pa mchong gi phur pa la 'dril/ /g.yon pa 'dzin byed lcags kyu bsnams/ /dpal ldan nag mo re ma dza/ /chibs su zha ba yu mo chibs/ /g.yas pa seng ldeng phur pa bsnams/ /dz+nyā g.yon pas stong khams khram la 'debs/ /dpal ldan nag mo re ma dzu/ /chibs su chu glang sngon mo chibs/ /g.yas pa lcags kyi phur pa gdengs/ /g.yon pa 'dzin byed lcags kyu bsnams/ /nam zla dus bzhi'i bdag mo mdzad/ /'jig rten khams kyi nad bdag mo/ /zhing lhags rlon pa'i na bza' can/ /ming po ma hā kā la ste/ /be con phur bu 'jol ber gsol/ /sku mdog nag po 'bar ba'i gdong / /ri rab nag po'i byang shar mtshams/ /mya le ding

'dril/ /kun kyang shan ba pho mo 'gyed/ /ri rab chen po'i sto nub mtshams/ /bse mtsho mer ba'i nang shed na/ /bse mkhar smug po'i pho brang nas/ sa bdag chen mo dam la 'dus/ /sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /bh+yo/ rdo rje gar gyi dbang phyug ma/ /rdo rje la gsal ba glog byin ma/ /rdo rje kun bzang mthu mo che/ /rdo rje ye shes chen mo ma/ /rdo rje gsung chen 'od 'bar ma/ /rdo rje gsung dbyangs sgrog ma mo/ /1 rdo rje sgrol ma za byed ma/ /ma bdun sku mdog dmar nag 'a/ /rdo rje phur 'dre' chas dang ldan/ /shar gyi rdo rje spyan gcig rma/ /lto yi rdo rje ral gcig ma/ /nub kyi rdo rje dbang sdud ma/ /byang gi rdo sgyu las mkhan mo/ /sring bzhi thag nag thod khrag dang / /phur 'dre' rang rang rgyan dang ldan/ /dkar ser dmar dang jing gu'i mdog /kun kyang phur ba'i spung rma ste/ /de ring dpa' gyi dam 'a 'dus/ /bos pa'i tshe na snyan ma sra/ /khyod dang nga

bka' yi srung rma khyod: mkhas btsun dkar gyi bdag mo yin: khyod kyi yab spru mtshan gsol pa: yab ni 'od de 'od bo che: khyod kyi yum 'a mtshan gsol ba: yum ni lha bzang ma mo lcam: de gnyis gangs dkar stod du bshos: srid pa'i lcam sring brgyad du srid: che zhe lha mo ngan ni ma: dmar mo dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: g.yas g.yon lcags kyu che yong 'dzin: dar nag go thu gtsug phud can: de 'og klu mo nor spru ngan: lcags kyus 'dzin zhing phur bus sgrol: de 'og gnod sbyin ngas spru ngan: lcags kyus 'gugs zhing bum par bskyil: de 'og 'dre mo zas 'a ngan: mi dzigs gyon nas ro 'angs zhon: 'ag na mchog phur lcags phur thogs: dral po de ni mi ring skyes: de 'og bse mdung dmar po can: de 'og shan pa ra mgo nag: tha chung zu ra ra skyes ni: mi nag rta nag mdung thung can: lcam dral brgyad po 'khor dang bcas: bstan pa gnyan bro bsrung ba'i phyir: rig 'dzin rnal

shes kyis: rdo rje phag mo'i dam tshig dang: bza 'byung gnas bka' rma gcog: bdag cag rna' 'byor 'khor bcas kyis: thugs dang 'ag ba'i mas bgyis na: nad rims da' kha'i rdul ma gtong: 'khon dang god kha dgra 'a bsgyur: bar chad zhi zhing tshe dpal rgyas: lha me'i 'du ba rgyun ma bcad: bkra sa gun sum tshogs par mdzod: ces brjod phud gtor gtsang sar gshegs so: zhes pa'ang rdzogs chen pa rang byung rdo rjes gu ru pad+ma'i man ngag las khol du byung ba'o: sa ma ya: dge'o/ /

cag gtso 'khor sprul pa yang sprul bcas /rnal 'byor bdag gis gnas 'dir spyan 'dren no/ /dgyes dgu'i mchod tshogs kun bzhes 'dod don sgrubs/ /slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' bsgos tha tshig don/ /ya' bar ma dor bcol ba'i phrin las kun/ /myur du thogs pa med par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa'ang rdo 7 blas so/ dge'o// // / lnga 5 / r+sha

zhing bse mkhar thag po zangs kyi sgo lcags can btsan mkhar 'jigs su rung ba'i dbus na tro bdun yongs su gyur pa las lha btsan dgra lha'i rgyal po tsi dmar /ba (mchog sprul mnga' ri ba chen pos dregs pa rang rgyud pa yin pas bskyed mi dgos gsung pa don la gnas kyang mngon rtogs yid ngor gsal ba'i slad du rgyal dbang lnga pa'i btsan mdog su gsungs pa la tshig phrad cung zad bsgyur te bkod pa/) sku mdog dmar ljang ral pa dmar po me 'od 'khrigs pa/ spyin nas me'i skar mda' li'akhrugs pa/ zhal nas khrag gi ser chen 'beb pa/ mche ba rnon po gangs ri ltar gtsigs pa/ ljags glog ltar 'khyag pa/ khro zhing 'jigs la rngams sgo zhing gtum pa/ sku spru dar dmar gyi sger chen za 'og sngo khra'i gong lag can gsol bar rin chen gser gyi ska rags bcing ba/ dbu la dar dmar gyi 'gying thod can/ stag dong g.yas dang gzig shub g.yon du 'phyang ba/ bse phub dmar po rgyab tu 'khyil ba/ phyag g.yas btsan gyi zhags ba dmar pos

kyi shang lang brdeg ba/ mtshal yu rting dkar sga srab can pe chibs pa/ ra tsa gong sngon gyi klu btsan sku mdog dmar nag 'jigs su rung ba/ sku la chu dar sngon po'i ral ga la dug sprul gyi ska rags bcings ba/ dar sngon gyi thod can/ stag dong g.yas dang gzig shub g.yon du 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas lcags mdung nag po dang g.yon skul gyi zhags pa 'phen ba/ rta ser po sga srab can la chibs pa/ rdo ring dmar po'i grib btsan sku mdog dmar po 'jigs pa'i gzugs can/ sger dmar gyi slog pa dang / dar dmar gyi khrod gsol ba/ stag dong g.yas dang gzig shub g.yon du 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas bse mdung dmar po dang / g.yon btsan gyi rgyu zhags bsnams pa/ skyung dmar sbo dkar sga srab can spru chibs pa/ rkang ka thod nag bdud btsan sku mdog ljang nag zhin tu 'jigs pa/ sku la dar nag ber chen dang / bdud dar nag bro thod du bcing ba/ stag dong g.yas dang gzig shub g.yon du

dmar po/ be har dkar mdzod gling la sogs rang bzhin gar bzhugs kyi gnas nas gnod sbyin dgra lha'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams bya rgod sha la bab pa ltar spyan drangs par gyur/ phroṃ/ rgya' ba kun gyi gsung mchog pad+ma'i gsung / /chos rje 'od dpag med ba rdo rje chos/ /spyan ras gzigs phyomi la sgyuḥlas rngam pa'i sku/ (btsan rgyud spu gri dmar po'i tshig yin/) rta mgrin rta skad bzhad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /kye phyogs phyogs de ni pha ke na: yirwa nyi ma nub phyogs pha ke na: btsan yum zangs thang dmar po na: pad+ma dbang gi bka' nyan ba: che btsan rol pa skyu bdun ni: phal cher sku mdog dzedamar po la: phyag na ba dan zhags ba bsnams: sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs dang bcas: tshur blon tshur byon gnas 'dir byon: shu spru tre badz+ra sa ma ya dza: zhes pa'i bar brjod rjes: skyes bu'i g.yas kyi ru 'dren pa/ (ru 'dren sde bzhi ni be har gyi sgos chos yin pa rje blon 'di gnyis dpon 'bangs res mos kyi

pa ri bgegs la rgyob/ /sngon gyi shul mtshon gshegs su gsol/ /skyes bu'i slad kyi rjes 'brang pa/ /ban che de ni sngags nag brgya/ /sngags nag phur ba hro 4 li/ /rak+ṣa'i phreng ba na ra ra/ /kha nas drag sngags sha ra ra/ /drag sngags gnod pa'i bgegs la gzir/ /phur nag gnod pa'i bgegs spru rgyob/ /slad kyi rjes 'brang gshegs su gso' / /skyeb bu'i sku yi skyo bsang ba/ /na chung de ni mdzes ma brgya/ /kha nas glu len kyu ru ru/ /dadul dkar me yong ta yol la/ /gser khri sgru ma phyod de phyod/ /gar 'bag sum brgya'i tshogs dang bcas/ /cang te'u de ni khra 'a la/ /gser gyi gdub bu si yi ske/ /sku yi skyo sgogrogs gshegs su gsol/ /phyi blon nang blon gshegs su gsol/ /'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol/ /sa mu ya dzaḥ skyo btsan mkhar dmar po'i nang shed na: sha khrag slongs spyod bsam mi khyab: yid 'ong spyan gzigs kun nas mdzes: dam tshig gtsang ma'i gdan spru bzhugs: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan:

'bar ba'i thugs dam bskang: sde brgyad sdong 'i thugs dam bskang: dkar srung dam can thugs dam bskang: las byed pho nya'i thugs dam bskang:gi: bse mkhar dmar po ldems sge ldem: dar dmar ru mtshon pu ru ru: ba dan dmar po yengs se yeng: dregs pa'i mda' 'phen brengs se breng:(blo las byed bzhan pa rol pho lo: bzhugs pa'i 'bod sgra di ri ri: che btsan rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang: slob dpon pad+ma'i spyin snga ru: thugs dam borwa zhal bzhes de dgongs la: khri srong lde'u btsan rje rigs dang: rnal 'byor dan ldan brgyud par bcas: dam tshig gcig tu skyong ba la: sku la bdo ba'i yārigs rgyud chod: phog lta'i sde dbung chom la phob: sngags 'chang rdo rje'i dam ma bral: bcol pho gnyer ro mthu rtsal bskyed: yal yol bri bka' rma /mdzad cig: ngo bsrung zas phyir ma 'brang mdzod: thugs dang 'ga' ba bskang gyur la: bu sdug tsha bo bzhin du skyongs: zhes brjod/ de nas khyad par gyi

'du ba snyi yi rten/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul te phul ba yis/ /gnod sbyin tsi'u danar po'i zugs dam bskang / /btsan rgod rol pa skyu bdun thugs /dam bskang / /thugs kyi dgyes sde btsun mo'i thugs dam bskang / /bka' sgron lha srin sde brgyad zugs dam bskang / /sprul 'khor ru 'dren sde bzhi'i 4 thugs dan bskang / /pos mkhan khye sbyang 'bag seng thugs dam bskang / /thugs dam bskang 'a las bzhi'i dngos grub stsol/ /mtshams sprin zhun ma'i rmi /mdangs kyi dar zab la/ /ha ri tsan+dan dri yi chus bskus te/ /skyes dar gri ru bkun ba'i snying khrig gis/ /bla rten srog gi 'khor yo'i phyag rgya bcos/ /ya pha wang yong bu hre yig snying bro can/ /sbu lcags tshigs ba bdun nam gsum pa'i nang / gtanas pa dar sna'i cod paṇa 'phur snying can/ /ting 'dzin rdo /rje'i gar gyis byin rlabs te/ /lus dang grib bzhin mi 'bram bcangs ba sogs/ /dachu can khye ltar 'brang ba nang gi rten/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis tham

mkhar gyi snying bor byas/ /ting 'dzin rdo rje'i gar gyis byin brlabs pa'i /dam can 'phru ltar chags pa gsang ba'i rten/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis tha' te phul ba yis/ /gnod sbyin tsi'u dmar po'i thugs dam bskang / /btsan rgod rol pa skyu bdun thugs dam bskang / /thugs kyi dgyes sde btsun mo'i 〈mi thugs dam bskang / /bka' blon lha srin sde brgyad thugs dam bskang / /sprul 'khor ru 'dren sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang / /las nakhan khyi sbyang 'bag rwa seng thugs dam bskang / /zugs dam bskang la 'as bzhi'i dngos grub stsol/ /zhin tu gsang ba dgra bo'i srog gi gshed/ /mdung zhags dmar po g.yul las rnam rgyal rten/ /se ba'i gnamu ru skyer pa'i nyag phran mda'/ /dug khrag ngar mas thags ba'i thun rngos dang / /nada' mo stong danar bya rgod sgro ldan la/ /gro dmar g.yang mo lug gi sug brang gdags/ /le brgan dar gyi cod baṇa pu ru ru/ /za 'og dmar khri'i khug mar gser g.yu dang / /rin chen

pa'i mnga' gsol/) thod greng rigs lnga'i brjod don snyi bar mdzod/ /ma bcos 'od gsal rig stong gnyug ma'i gzhis/ /lta sgom bya rtsom zhig pa gdod /na'i ngang / /phan gnod lha 'dra'i kun rtog rnam dag kyang / /rol rtsa' thugs rje'i rnan rol cir yang ston/ /snang cha 'dzin ba'i rten 'brel zhar ba snyeblo nas/ /'khor 'das bar 'ag bral ba srid pa'i lhatsho/ /byang phyogs mi yul lcang ra zug po ru/ /yi rje ut+pal sras lhachog 'byor bar grags/ /de tshe bag shirwa chag dkar po'i drod gsher gyis/ /dad pa'i myu gu chos su zhin ba las/ /nags tshal dben par skyo ba'i 'du shes kyis/ /bag yod dka' thub brten te rmiganas ba 'as/ /rgya' po'i bu mo lha lcam bde 'byin ma/ /rdzing bur khrus spru brtse ba sbrul gyis bdas/ /de nyid srog la bskyabs zhing phan btags pa'i/ /sgron pos kha na rmu tho rje 'a bsgrags/ /ma brtags phra ma nyan pa'i btsan po des/ /mi sras dge sprong bkun du phyogs pa 'as/ /lha sum rmo rgyus bsnyad skrung /

bdun/ /dam pe brtags te bstan ba'i bsrung mar bskos/ /dang po 'dul khrims srung ba'i dge slong che/ /bar du tshangs spyod nyams pa'i gdug pa can/ /tha ma srid gsum sung ba srog gi gshed/ /da lta bstan pa srung ba'i mthu rtsal can/ /khyod ni sngon gyi mas dang bag chags mthus/ /rgyan rigs 〈blo bstan ba gas yongs kyi bdud du che/ /rnal 'byor yongs kyi mgon skyabs dgra lhar che/ /de phyir dbu 'phang gnyan po bstod bar bgyi/ /rtogs na sta gdod ma'i snyagon dang ro gcig kyang / /gha rtogs snang ngor rang rgyud dregs pa'i tshul/ /nga bdag gzung 'dzin bral ba'i dbyings chen po/ /mas rlung rnam rtog 'dzoms bar mnga' gsol yo/ /med byung lung rtogs mkhyen brtse nus ba'i mthus/ /thar med srid mtshor dub ba'i 'gro ba rnams/ /rnam lhakhyen rin chen gling du khrid nus ba'i/ /ded dpon thams cad mkhyen bar mnga' gso' yo/ /kun brtags snang ba'i grong khyer chen po'i gzhir/ /dag bar ye

bzhi'i btegs ba'i lang tshos mdzes/ /dbang po lnga dang stobs lnga'i bang 'gros mgyogs/ /sa bcu gcig char bgrod pa'i rlung gshog can/ /rta mchog rin chen mchog du nanga' gsol yo/ /rtag chad phyogs su snya lhung mngon sum gnad /'od gsal rdzogs chen bsgom pa'i rnam 'byor la/ /sna tshogs g.yo tsho rgol ba'i phog rtog bdud/ /'joms pa'i darmug dpon chen por mnga' gsol lo/ /rgyal srid rin chen bdun gyi mthu chen pos/ /kha na snya thos g.yeng dz+wa ba'i rgyal phran rnams/ /rang dbang brtan pa 'phrog te spa bkong ba'i/ /'khor yos bsgyur ba'i rgyal por mnga' gsol lo/ /snyigs ma'i rang stobs bdo ba'i mun gling du/ /sdug bsngal gsum gyi khur gyis nyams thag tshe/ /bde skyid rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i khri gdugs can/ /mgron du 'bod pa'i pho ltar mnga' gsol yo/ /rigs gsum sgyu 'phrul ches dbon rnam gsum gyi/ /chos srid khrims kyi nyi snya chu lhar phyogs/ /sgod bcud kun gyi bkrag snyadangs

phog bar bsgyur dang chabs gcig bar/ /nad mtshon mu ge'i sna 'dren byed pa yi/ /rgyal 'gong 'joms pa'i gshed por mnga' gso' yo/ /rnam dag smon /pa'i ri mo bris min par/ /'ongs spyod bsod nams dpung pa'i she mong gi/ /bod kyi mnga' ris 'phrog pa'i dam sri'i dpung / /gson snying dmar por 'don par mnga' gsol lo/ /mchod bstod dregs ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po ru/ /bka' bsgos dam spru bzhag pa'i srung ma rnams/ /khyod gsod glo bur na lhag pa'i 'dre rgod dpung / /brlag ba'i drang srong khro bor mnga' gsol pho/ /dathen par chos bzhin spyad kyang mi bzod par/ /dug lnga'i 'thor rlung drag tāpos rgyud dkrugs shang / /yon sbyor slob mar bcas la gshe ba yi/ /dam yog srog gi gshed mar mnga' gsol lo/ /phrag dog rlung dmar 'tshub pa'i ngan sngags kyis/ /mthu byed me dpung sbar ba'i rno dbal mtshon/ /drang srong dmod ba'i gnam lcags thog mda' yis/ /rang gshed rang 'a dbab par

'phrod pa'i spun ltar mnga' gsol snying ma rings/ /mdza' ba'i grogs ltar mnga' gso' gzhung ma ngan/ /gcugs pa'i sring ltar mnga' gsol dung ma chung / /nyan pa'i g.yog ltar mnga' gsol rgab ma ngan/ /dbu 'phang ri rgyal lhun po lta bur bstod/ /gzi byin nyi zla'i dpa' las che bar marjod/ /de 62 nas phrin bcol bya ba ni/ lhu hrīḥ sngon tshe kun bzang rta mchog he ru gas: 'og min cho 'phrul bstan pa'i zhing khams su: dam la btags zhing bka' — —3 yi rtsis rgyar bzhag: rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa'i gnyer du bskos: bar du dur khrod me ri 'bar ba'i gnas: btsan brag dmar po srin mo 'ang 'dra ru: tshirig 'dzin slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: ye shes 'khor lo'i phyag rgyar bzhugs pa las: nam gung mun pa'i smag la bab ba'i tshe: spyang ke khrag gi ral can bdun brdzus nas: du zhing bar gcod drag pos glags bltas tshe: bka' rtags phyag rgya'i thim 'og bcug min nam: tha mar mchog sprul mnga'

spyang skyongs: gnas lnga shes byar srid pa'i chos so cog: thugs kyi dba' ber 'khyil dang chab gcig bar: snang ba ཿ mar rtogs pa'i mkhas grub rnams:mdzad pa phrin las nam mkha'i pha mthar son: tha snyad shes bya'i gos kyis klub min yang: zab don bskyed rdzogs lang tsho gsar pa'i gzi: ri sul dben tsho par ngoms pa'i grub thob rnams: 'ja' lus mkha' spyod grub pa'i them skas tshugs: gzhan don rlabs chen spyod pa'i mthu chung yang: rang don chos shi2 bzhin spyod pa'i ku su lu'i: nyams chung gyi nas 'tsho ba'i chos ldan rnams: 'tsho skyong yon gyi bdag po khyed kyis gyis: bskal par mas nyon ṣ+ṭhas bon btab pa'i mthus: sdug bsngal gsum gyi 'bras bu smin pa'i ro: myong ba'i sems can gang gā'i rdul snyed grangs: bde skyid dpa' la spyod pa'i sgo 'phar phyes: khyad par rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag gi: sem sa bskyed smon pa'i rang gzugs smin pa las: gzhan phan par phyin drug gi lam po che:

pa'i rgyud 'a 'byor ba'i brtan g.yo kun: khyed la gnyer du gtad do mel tshe gyis: srid dang zhi ba'i phun tshogs mgron du khyag: rtsod dang don gnyer kun las rgyal kha yong: snyan pa'i ba dan srid pa'i rtse mor sgrengs: grags ba'i sku khyud gling bzhi'i mtha' spru skor: mdor na bsam pa'i don dang 4mi gnyer ba'i las: the tshom rnam nur med par khyed kyis sgrubs: gzhi byes lam gsum kun du sdong grogs mdzod: phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i phrin las yorwa mdzod: dung dung snying nas mi brjed gsol ba 'debs: yang yang mchod cing bstod nas bdag sogs kun: 'jigs 'jigs bar chad dgra las rnam tārgyal zhing: 'dzum 'dzum dgyes pa'i sgo nas dngos grub stsol: zhes brjod cing mchod gtor gtsang sar gshegs par bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ bem po'i rang bzhin gdos bcas sgyu ma'i lus/ /rin chen srog gi zung dang bral ba'i gshis/ /bsam tshe dkon mchog rin chen rnam gsum las/ /dregs pa'i skyabs gnas nam mkha'i pad+mar

pa thams cad kun/ /dpa' ba'i ke bas cha sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs/ /dge mtshan snyan pa'i ba dan mkha' pe shar/ /rdo rje'i rta mchog bzhin pa'i blo gar gyis/ /bar chad dam sri'i srog snying tshal par 'gem/ /byin rlabs sprin 'khrigs dngos grub char rgyun 'bebs/ /skal ldan bdag gis mchod cing mnga' gsol na/ /thogs med thugs rje'i dbang gis 'dir gshegs la/ /bdud rtsi dpal skyems phud kyi mchod pa bzhes/ /bcud ldan yid bzhin gtor ma'i sa mchod pa bzhes/ /khrag chang phyos byed martse mchod pa bzhes/ 'od gsal dri zhim bsang gi mchod pa bzhes/ /dar sna ba dan rol mo'i mchod pa phra bzhes/ /bde stong nyams myong gsang ba'i mchod pa bzhes/ /snang srid gzhir bzhengs mdos kyi mchod ba bzhes/ /thams cad mnyam nyid ye shes mchod pa bzhes/ /thugs rjes dgongs shag seng chen rin po che/ /dam bca' ma g.yel rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku/ /deng nas byang chub bar du mi 'bral bar/ /

gnas nas/ /sa 'am mngon par rtogs pa cher 'phel zhing / /myur du rnam grol rgyal ba'i dbang por mdzod/ zhes pa'ang / lcags 'brug zla ba drug pa'i tshes nyer bzhi la mi pham bas gang shar bris pa dge'o/ /hre

med bgegs kyi dbung / /me lce'i zer gyis phye ma pheb ji bzhin/ /phyogs 'as rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal rnga brdungs/ /mdor na dus gsum kun tu khyod bsten na/ /gzhi la rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i ljon skang tshugs/ /byes su lam 'phrang yul ngan chom rkun skyobs/ /'gyed dang don gnyer kun las rgyal kha yong/ /bsam don 'bras bur smin pa'i grin mas mdzod/ /ces pa'ang sde ba bka' blon gyi dgongs bzhed ltar rgyal mkhar gyi rnam sras rten la dmigs nas rdzogs chen pa rang byung rdo rjes so/ /

gsol na/ /dar dkar ras dkar gsol/ /chibs su ci chibs na/ /lha rta ngang dkar chibs/ /khams gsum kun tu rgyu/ /mdog dkar 'od zer /'bar/ /g.yas pas tha lcag phyar/ /ma bdun las la 'gyed/ /g.yon pas shel phreng 'dren/ /zugs dam dbyings su sgros/ /sprul pa ci 'gyed na/ /lha dmag 'bum sde 'gyed/ /bran g.yog 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir byon phrin las mdzod/ /dam can kun gyi lha/ /dam med kun gyi gshed/ /mna' zan kun gyi bdud/ /rnam 'byor kun gyi dpa'/ /sgrub mchog bdag gi grogs/ /phrin las bka' phog pa/ /spyo ba'i 'dre 'dul zhing / /sdang ba'i dgra srog gcod/ /mgyogs su rta rtod gyis/ /mig thog thor ma snyi/ /rno ru mtshon dor gyis/ /rtse mo dbal ma zhan/ /ci dang do bsdo na/ /do thag chod ta re/ /mgyogs dang dkyus mnyam na/ /dkyus thag shor ta re/ /sdang dgras khyer ta re/ /byams kyis skyong ta re/ /dus la bab po sa ma ya/ /dam

po ri/ /dbang chen pad+ma he ru kus/ /dbang du bsdus pa mi dran nam/ /tha ma ri rgyal bkra bzang gi/ /rtse mor lha srin kun bsags nas/ /dpa' chen rdo rje gzhon nu yis/ /dam tsheg phog pa mi dran nam/ /nga ni pad+ma 'byung gnas yin/ /khyod ni gnyan chen thang lha yin/ /yul ni dbus gtsang ru bzhi yin/ /byin rlabs sbrin ltar jibs se thob/ /thugs rje char ltar sha ra ra/ /dam tshig mdangs ldan ya 'a pe/ /thang lha gnyan bro gshegs su gsol/ /sku lha gnyan po 'khor bcas 'a/ /ba da ldan bzang rigs bshos kyis mchod/ /g.ya' chu gangs chu gtsang mas mchod/ /dri zhim thos dkar dud bas mchod/ /gser dadul rin chen sna lngas mchod/ /sdon cha dar dang tha 'og mchod/ /gsang lug 'bras dkar gtsang mas mchod/ oṃ badz+ra thang ka ra sku nying khya sha lam̐ ma mi ta kha haṃ khā haṃ hwa hā/ /ces bgrangs so/ /byang gter cha lag go/ /

babang po dang / /mkha' sding gser mig 'khyil pa dang / /chos skyong ma hā kā la dang / /dri za thur phud lnga pa sogs/ /phyi yi sde brgyad 'khor bcas 'a/ /mchod pa dam ba 'di 'bul pho/ /gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la/ /bdag gi 'dod don bsgrub tu gsol/ /yab cig bdud rje nag po dang / /btsan rgyal yam shud dmar po dang / /yul lha phywa sang klu sras dang / /srog bdag rgya' po snying 'byin dang / /chos skyong gnod sbyin dmar po dang / /lha mo 'jigs pa'i glog 'byin dang / /dge bsnyen rdo rje legs ba dang / /dkar mo nyi zla'i thod phreng sogs/ /nang gi sde brgyad 'khor bcas 'a/ /mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul pho/ /gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la/ /bdag gi 'dod don bsgrub tu gsol/ /bdud po kha thun rab dang / /gzhin rje gshed po dper po dang / /klu bdud mā ga rā dza dang / /gnod sbyin zhan ba gri thogs dang / /ma mo srid pa'i khram 'debs dang / /btsan po

rjer sprul pa dang / /lag g.yon klu btsan sprul ba dang / /mig dang snying dang mche ba gsum/ /gza' bdud nyid du sprul pa sogs/ /sprul pa'i sde brgyad 'khor bcas la/ /mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul yo/ /gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes spru/ /bdag gi 'dod don bsgrub tu gsol/ /sa bdag hal khye nag po dang / /klu bdud sgo ra nag po dang / /sa yi lha mo brtan ma dang / /phyogs skyong rgyal chen sde bzhi dang / /mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga dang / / sheyul 'di'i gzhi bdag thams cad dang / /pho lha dgra lha srog lha dang / /mo lha mo sman la sogs pa'i/ /snang srid sde brgyad 'khor bcas la/ /ma chod pa paṃdam pa 'di 'bul lo/ /bser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la/ /bdag gi 'dod don bsgrub tu gsol/ /zhes pa 'di yang ser ba bsrung ba / sri'u gso ba/mdos glud gtong ba/ gtor zor 'phen pa sogs las gang byed kyi sngon du 'gro ba'i sde brgyad mchod pa 'di med na/ byis pas mkhar las byed pa dang 'dra bas/ las gang

༈ / /byang chub sems dang ldan pa'i skyes bu yis/ /thugs bskyed dam bca' mi nyams bstan 'gro'i don/ /skal med thar pa'i sa bon 'debs pa la/ /dam can rgyal mtsho'i ru nga phrag dog sbongs/ /zhin tu gdul dka' las 'brel med pa'i rigs/ /bka' srung dregs pa'i za kha zug pa pe/ /phyi tshul 'jam po'i 'brel ba bzhag na'ang / /bka' sdod pho nya'i tshogs kyis za du gyis/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe brtan ba dang / /rgyal bstan dar sgergyas 'gro ba'i bde skyed spel/ /dmag jag chom po'i las ngan rgyun bcad de/ /bsam don lhun gyis 'grub pa'i srin 'as /dzod/ /dpal sprul pas so/ / kyā

dam bcas kyang / /sgom pa yun thung bzlas grangs nyung ba dang / /bsnyen bsgrub g.yel zhing cho ga lhag chad gyur/ /mchod gtor bsham nyes sbyor sgrol las mtha' los /gsang sgo 'chol zhing bka' las 'das pa'i skyon/ /'gal 'khrul nyams chag thams cad mthol yo bshags/ /nyams dang 'grogs shing yo nyams pa skong ba dang / /nyams la chos bshad nyams dang tshogs 'dres dang / /nyams pe mi 'dzem nyams chag zhig ral gyur/ /nyams grib skyon rnams sak+ta thams cad mthol lo ba dgas / /yun ring dus nas bsnyen cing bsgrub pa'i lha/ /dam can srung ma'i thugs dang 'gal gyur pa/ /dus su ma mchod bsnyen lngu sgrub ma tshang dang / /las mtha' ma longs mngon spyod las la bskul/ /gtsang sbu nyams zhing lta sgom ma dag dang / /brtse gdung rgyun chad mchod pas ma bskang dang / /skong ba ma rdzogs cho ga lhag chad gyur/ /nyams chag nyes lhung bag med 'gal 'khrul kun/ /mthol pho bshags so byang zhing dag par

gzhan don 'grub nas/ /bdag snang dbang sdud gzhan snang zil gnon cing / /sa 'dir sgrub pa'i sde la dar rgyas mdzod/ /phyi nang bka' srung yul lha tho dor dang / /'go ba'i lha lnga skyob pa'i lha rnams dang / /srung skyob mdzad pa'i lha srung thams cad dang / /dben gnas phyi nang srung ma thams cad la/ /tswa rnam dag bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di 'bum lo/ /kha kha khra haṃ khā haṃ bha ling ta/ /bzhes nas yu' ris rgyal khams thams cad kyi/ /mi nad phyugs nad dal h+phu /yams rgyun chod la/ /pho phyugs rtag legs char chu dus 'bebs zhing / /bdag gzhan 'dod don ma lus myur 'grub mdzod/ /rgya/ kun bzang zhi khro rab 'byams rdo rje 'chang / /rdo rje sems dpa' thub dbang bcom ldan 'das/ /gsang ba'i bdag po dga' rab thi seng / /yongs kyi gtso mchog yo rgyan thod phreng rtsa'/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum mchog mkhar chen bza'/ /'dzam gling rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan/ /rgya bod yo paṇa grub thob tshogs rnams dang / /

yid 'a rnam bar grol ba'i shes rab kyis/ /zag med bde bas nam ya nga ngoms par mdzod/ /rtag tu khyod gsol khyod mchod khyod bsgrubs na/ /mthu rtsal ma chung brtse gdung che bar mdzod/ /gzhis la bkra zhis 'ongs spyod phun sum tshogs /byes su 'am 'phrang chu las sgrol 'don mdzod/ /'jigs pa'i dgra jag chom thun 'tshe ba skyobs/ /mdor na bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyis/ /bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub pa la/ /'gal rkyen bar chad ma lus zhi ba dang / /mthun rkyen ma lus lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod/ /gang zhig yid 'a dran pa tsam gyis ni/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub ster bar mdzad pa yi/ /chos skyong yid bzhin nor bu khyed rnams kyis/ /bdag gi bsam don ma lus 'grub par mdzod/ /sdon tshe lgo rgyan chen po'i spyan snga ru/ /chos bzhin sgrub par byed pa'i gang zag pe/ /ma yis bu bzhin skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /chos skyong srung ma rnams
———————————————— —————————————sne/ /chos skyong grin bcom bkra skam dge thegs bzhugs/ /

'grub par mdzad du gsol/ bdag gi lus dang / yongs spyod dang / 'khor 'bangs dang / tha na sems sku rnam rtog yan chad bla ma dang bstan pa'i zhabs tog tu 'gyur bar mdzad du gsol/ de ltar 'gyur ba la bar du gcod pa'i rkyen phyi'i dgra/ nang gi bdud/ gsang ba'i nyon mongs/ gdug /bra /rtsub lha 'dre'i 'tshe ba thams cad ming yang mi grags par mdzad du gsol/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi rten 'brel thams cad legs pa'i phyogs su dri 'grigs te phan bde nam mkha' dang mnyam par mdzad du gsol/ gdul bya sems can rnams skrung dad pa dang dam tshig rnam par dag pa dang ldan zhing ṭī pa /zab lam gsang chen gyi bstan pa rnya ma shar ba ltar 'gyur bar mdzad du gsol/ dang bro thos/ thos don bsam/ bsam don sgoms/ kun kyang rtse /gcig sgrub pa la gzhol te nyams len sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa rdzogs ldan ltar rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ sgrub ba nyams su len pa'i gang zag rnams kyang

zhing dag nas sor chud cing : nyi zla gza' las thar ba bzhin: lha me'i bkrag mdangs gzi ba da rgyas: mthu stobs nus pa'i rtsal 'bar gyur: i ca na ḍāk+ki ni tur smi te tsit+ta ku le rgya:re skyu ra ṇa bsregs: me pho ra ṇa gtor: ṇa s+pha ra ṇa sbyangs: so ha ra ṇa :: sang nge sa le ye swā hā: ci nus bzla zhing rdzas la bsngags: kye/ lha skang shug pa sur dkar dang : mkhan dkar spros sman sbyar ba yi: dud pa rlung dang bdud rtsi'i khrus: rnal 'byor shibadag dang bsrung bya yi: de ring btsog grib thams cad bsang : de ring nad grib thams cad bsang : de ring 'khon grib thams cad bsang : de ring lha dam grib thams cad bsang : de ring nyams grib thams cad bsang : mdze bo'i grib kyis phog pa bsang : yugs sa'i grib kyis rdzog pa bsang : dme yi grib kyis phog pa bsang : nal gyi grib phrog thams cad bsang : gzhin po'i ro grib phrog pa bsang : gson po'i bang grib phrog pa bsang : gnas

sna: khang grib kyis rdzog pa bsang: gos kyi grib phrog thams cad bsang : zas kyi grib phrog thams cad bsang : yo byad grib kyis phog ba bsang : gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya yi: rkyen byung grib kyis phog pa bsang : kye: rnam 'byor bdag dang bsrung bya yi: sku yi lha rnams mnol na yang : bsang 1 khrus 'di yis dag gyur cig: gsung gi lha rnams mnol na yang : bsang khrus 'di yis dag gyur cig: thugs kyi lha rnams mnol na yang : bsang khrus ju‘ ba 'di yis dag gyur cig: yon tan lha rnams mnol na yang : bsang khrus 'di yis dag gyur cig: phrin las lha rnams mno' na yang : bsang khrus 'di sla ba yis dag gyur cig: rgyab rten lha rnams mnol na yang : bsang khrus 'di yis dag gyur cig: mgon skyabs lha rnams mnol na yang : bsang khrus 'di yis dag gyur cig: pha lha gnyan spro mnol na yang : bsang khrus 'di yis dag gyur cig: ma lha gnyan bro mnol na yang : bsang khrus 'di yis dag

gyur cig: zhang lha gnyan po mnol na yang : bsang khrus 'di yis dag gyur cig: dgra lha gnyan po mnom na yang : bsang khrus 'di yis dag gyur cig: srog lha gnyan po mnol na yang : bsang khrus 'di yis dag gyur cig: mig gi dbang po mnol na yang : bsang khrus 'di yis dag gyur cig:rna ba'i dbang po mnol na yang : bsang khrus 'di yis dag gyur cig: sna yi dbang po mnol na yang: bsang khrus 'di yis dag gyur cig: lce yi tshwadabang po mnol na yang : bsang khrus 'di yis dag gyur cig: snying gi dbang po mnol na yang: bsang khrus 'di yis dag gyur cig: lus kyi dbang po sla mnol na yang : bsang khrus 'di yis dag gyur gci: phung khams skye mched mnol na yang : bsang khrus 'di yis dag gyur cig: zas gos yo byad mnol na yang : bsang khrus 'di yis dag gyur cig: gnas rten bran khol mnol na yang: bsang khrus 'di yis dag gyur cig: nor zas yongs spyod

ma: mnol na yang: bsang khrus 'di yis dag gyur cig: rta nor sgo khyi mnol na yang : bsang khrus 'di yis dag gyur cig: dbang thang dpal yon ske mnol na yang : bsang khrus 'di yis dag gyur cig: ye shes me yis bsregs gyur cig: rtsal shugs rlung gis gtor gyur cig: bdud rtsi khrus kyis ༷ dag gyur cig: ba sbrin bral shel gong phyis: nam mkha' g.ya' dag ji bzhin du: nyes pa'i skyon dang bral gyur cig: de ring rnal 'byor bdag cag / gedzi gi: mnol grib mi gtsang 'gal rkyen dag: bla ma rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs: yi dam lha yis dngos grub rtsol: ma dang mkha' 'gros nus mthu stochi bskyed: chos skyong srung mas phrin las sgrub: lha srin sde brgyad bran du khol: lus la bkrag mdangs gzi ba da 'bar: ngag la snyan 'gyur nus pa bskyed:sems la bde skyid nyams rtogs 'phel: mi 'dod nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing : tshe bsod ye shes yon tan rgyas: gzhan sems zas nor dbang du 'dus:

dgra gdon 'byung po tshar chod nas: phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba yi: lha klu gnod sbyin g.yang khu ye: bkra shas bde skyid phun tshogs shog: grib mnol bsang khrus bde legs kun 'byung 'di: mkha' 'gro'i ming po khrug 'thung rdo rje la: lcags pho byi lo'i mchu zla'i dmar phyogs su: rten ldan sgrol dkar yid bzhin nor ཿsa gnang : byin rlabs yon tan mang du gsungs pa thob: lo gcig bar du gsang rgya dam par byas: phag lo dpo zla'i yar tshes dge ba la: mi lam bskul ma byung ltar dag snang babaX byi rlabs nas pa che zhing rtags mtshan mthongaX yi ge'i 'ad byed rig pa'i ye shes bgyis: rnam rtog bdad kyi g.yal las rgyal bar zhog: bkra skas: ༷ca na ca ༄ ༄ ༄ ca

sgrib sbyangs/ /khams gsum ma lus dag pa'i zhing du gyur/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me ṅgi hrīḥ brgya rtsa brjod/ na mo/ bde gshegs snying pos 'gro ba yongs spru khyab//sems ni rgya chen mchog tu rab bskyed de/ /'gro ba 'di dag ma lus sangs rgyas rgyu/ /'di na snod min sems can gang yang med/ /bzhings shig bzhengs skya ga stobs bcu mnga' ba'i lha/ /dus las mi 'da' thugs rje'i dbang gis ni/ /sems can don 'a dgongs ba'i dkon mchog gsum/ /yid kyis sprul zhing : bshams pa'i gnas 'di ru/ /rgyal ba 'khor bcas ma lus gshegs su gsol/ /zhing khams rgya mtsho'i mgron rigs mchog dman thams cad byon nas mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ /oṃ āḥ lan gsum brjod/ du ba 'di 'dod yon gyi lha mo gzugs rdo rje ma mdzes snying lta na sdug pa/ dbyangs snyan /ba/ dri zhim pa/ reg bya 'jam pa/ phyag gnyis na lha'i bdud rtsi ro brgya dang ldan pa'i bum ba bsnams nas mchod pa'i sprin phung dpag tu med par

nang bcud kyi sems can dpa' tho mkha' 'gro'i grong khyer/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ gnas sum cu rtsa gnyis/ dur khrod chen po brgyad/ mkha' spyod dang sa spyod kyi bdag po dpa' ldan rdo rje phag mo/ rgyal yum rdo rje rnal 'byor rma/ khros ma nag mo dang seng ge'i gdong can/ ku ru kusle dang 'od zer can/tsha dpa' dang nor rgyun ma/ bkra shes kyi lha mo brgyad/ khro gnyer can dang ri khrod ma/ yum chen mo pe sogs te gsang sngags dang rig sngags gzungs sngags shā kyi lha mo rnams spru 'bul pho/ /bdag gi dam tshig nyams chag thams cad bskang nas phrin mas rnam pa bzhi thogs med du 'grub pa dang / 'chi khar gnad gcod kyi sdug bsngal mi 'byung zhing lam sna dang bsun ma mdzad du gsol/ oṃ āḥ / bcom ldan 'das shākya thub bas mtshon bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis/ sangs rgyas dga' ba'i dba' la sogs phyogs bcu dang mar me mdzad dang rnam gzigs spru sogs dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas/ mchog

shes dang pes las grub pa'i chos skyong ma mgon lcam dral/ dbal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga/ dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud/ lha klu yum lha gzhi bdag 'dzam bu gling dang gangs can na gnas pa'i dge bsnyen dkar phyogs skyong ba'i ming dang mtshan nas ma thon pa thams cad spru 'bul pho/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan ba srungs/dza dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ 'jig rten gyi khams su char chu dus su phobs/ nad mug 'khrug rtsod sol/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag chos sgrub pa'ibar yo: chad srung zhing yon bdag dang gnas mal mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ āḥ / gzhan yang lha klu mi dang bram ze'i drang srong bden tshig grub pa'i tshogs/ gnod / tso sbyin dzam bha pe/ lhan cig skyes pa'i lha 'go ba'i lha lnga/ khyim lha dang zhing lha la sogs kha rje dang dbang thang skyed pa'i lha 'byung ba bzhi dang ri dang nags /tshal gyi lha rnams la 'bul pho/ /bdag gi legs pa dang dkar po'i phyogs thams cad bskyed pa'i sdong grogs mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ āḥrgya/ dri za'i rgyal po ci

'dus pa'i phung po/ tshor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin/ 'jigs skrag 'khrul snang gis mnar ba/ 'khyag stogs skom gsum gyis gdung ba/ tshe tshad nges /pa med ba/ bya sgro rlung gis btegs pa bzhin/ gar 'gro'i rang dbang dang bram ba'i bar do'i sems can che ge mos gtsor byas pa'i bar dor gnas pa thams tsho cad 'a 'bu' lo/ /gnas grogs yongs spyod bza' btung phun sum tshogs pa dang phrad nas bag phebs par gyur cig /de ltar gyur pa'i mod spru 'phags shā ba sbyan ras gzigs dang / byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa rnam se' mthong nas bar do spru bar do yin par ngo shes/ 'khrul snang rgyas thebs/ bla ma dang dkon mchog yi dam dang lta ba rjes su dran te/ las ngan pa'i sgrib pa skad cig la dag nas rig ba spru rang dbang thob/ bde ba can dang pad+ma 'od 'a sogs pa'i zhing khams khyad par can btsan thabs su bgrod nus par shog cig rgyal ba mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /dam can thugs dam bskang gyur cig /
