kyang / gsur mchod bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin 'di/ nyid kyi mthus bdag dang sems can gyi don du bzhes la/ 'jam dpa' dbyangs kyi mkhyen pa/ phyag na rdo rje'i nus stobs/ spyan ras gzigs kyi snying rje/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi yongs spyod/ byams pa mgon po'i rnam thar/2 rgyal sras rnams kyi thugs bskyed ngo mtshar bla na rmed pa srid zhi'i khams na mtshungs pa med pa'i bden pa dang / bden ba'i tshag des bdag gi spe chod sbyin spra bzar zhing 'byor pa rgya che bas /bams gsum rigs drug gi sems can tshem par byed nus par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ oṃ āḥrgya/ nyan thos dang rang — rgyal/ dgu bcom ba zan pa zad ba/ bya ba byas pa/ //khur bor ba/ /gsog 'thog spangs pa/ srid pa 'as 'das pa'i ye shes brnyes pa rnams kyang bdag gi bsam ba rnam bar dag pas sbyar ba'i gsur mchod ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'dis bsod snyoms kyi bya ba mdzad nas/ bdag gi yon bsngo ba ma sems

dang / de dag gi sde dang spruspror du gtogs pa'i 'byung bo che phra thams cad la gsur mchod ye shes gyi bdud rtsi 'di rang rang gang la gang dgos ci la ci 'dod kyi yo byad du rgyan ba sras dang bcas pa'i bden sdug gis byin gyis brlabs nas 'bul gyi de de bzhin du bzhes 'a rgyal ba thugs rje'i ba dag nyid 4 des byang chub kyi sems/ 'dod dgu'i bang mdzod/ 'gro ba lha dang bcas ba'i bgo skal du bzhag pa 'di spru thugs mnyes par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ āḥ dz+wa〉 rgya/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin 'a zhen cing / bdag gir 'dzin pa 'a gdung ba skye ba/ yang dang yang du srid ji ཿgo par skye ba'i chos can/ bdag la chags/ gzhan spru stang / gnyis su rmongs pa'i rang bzhin snang ba rags ba spru zhen cing / gdos bcas kyi lus kyis /bcings pa rnams skad cig gis 'du mi nus zhing phra mo'i zas kyis tshom bar mi 'gyur na'ang / bdag gi snying rje chen bo'i stobs kyis khams gsum gyi

tshim sla/ ga/nan zas ri bo tsam la'ang gdung ba mi skyed par/ bzhin snum gyi le/ sto sgregs pa chil le/ bag dro phan phe/ dus rtag tu chos spyod dang /sgrib sbyong la brtson nas/ dad pa dang 'dun pa'i yul du gyur cig /oṃ āḥlha/ gzhan yang zas slong mo la brten pa/ gos phyag dar la re ba/zu gzhan gyi sgo nyul ba/ bzhin thal mdog ltar 'dug sa / skad rtol snyom ltar 'thod pa/ 'ag pa dang phor pa bzed pa/ dbyug pa dang kug stong thogs yista pa/ ngo shes kyi ming nas 'bod pa/ ngo mi shes pa 'a ngo bstod byed pa/ dbyar gsum skyur la re bas snod ngo dang bkru bzhan slong ba/ ston gsum kūgo 'bru la re bas phyar snyigs dang ste phyag slong ba/ dpyid gsum mar la re bas btsag snyigs dang skog rog rtsod pa/ dgun gsum sha la re bas dus //btogs dang khu snyigs slong ba/ yang nas yang du slong ba/ da nangs byin na do dgong 'ong ba/ de ring byin na sang nyin 'ong ba/ kyi thong kha spru btags

gang rung du skyes pa/ 'khrul snang du ma 'a spyod pa/ nyin mtshan go phog tu rigar ba/ 'khyags ltog skom gsum gyis gdung ba/ bkres snang dang zas snang /rgyun chad med ba/ rtag tu sgo dang khyim nyul zhing / zas skom dang 'byor pa mthong yang phongs spyod rgyu med pa/ 'jigs skrag dang zhe sdang gis spe nar ba/shu mig gson ma blta ba/ sha lag gson spru gzed pa/ ska sems gson 'a chags pa/ dung skad la rgyugs pa/ bgos gra' du 'tshogs pa/ bza' shi〉 btung 'a re ba/ bgos byed par song kyang skal ba med pa/ lag pa bzed kyang gzhan gyis mi mthong / ma ma thong tsa na zhe sdang 'ang ba/ yul mun dub bla go ltar snang ba/ lus grib ma ltar 'dug pa/ kha char dang bu yug gis gdung ba/ sngo la gnag pa/ skya la skem pa/ ser 'a btsa' ba/ bzhin mi sdug pa/skad ngan pa/ zas 'a re ba/ skom spru gdung ba/ ja lo ngan snyi gas la 'du ba/ snab dang kha lud len pa/ gsur dang gtor ma la gdung ba thams /

cad dam ba'i chos bzhin spyod pa la nges par spro ba'i thabs kyi sgo 'a nan tan mdzad du gso' yo/ /dpal mo rgyan gyi blob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la sogs sngon byon grub pa'i skyes bu rnams kyi bka' dang dam 'a ma 'da' bar yangs ba'i rgya' khams chos bzhin skyong ba'i sa dbang sde dge rgyal 〉 po'i bka' phung 'phrin las kyi pho nya ba kha bsgyur gnyer zur pad+ma chos 'phel gyi bzhed don thams cad gegs med yid bzhin du 'grub ba'i sdong grogs tsha mdzad du gsol/ khyad par du chags sdang gi rtog pa la ma 'thas shing / snang ba rmi 'am lta bu la bden par zhen pa'i dbang gis 'byung po mi ma yin pa'i ge lus su gyur nas rgya' khams mi bde ba 'khrugs pa'i thabs pe brtson par byed ba'i dpon rgan bsod nams bstan pa/ dpon ngag dbang / sras dpal chen mgon po/ dbang chen kur tshe spru sogs pa las kyi rdzu 'phru' gyi shugs kyis rgyu ba rnams kyang gsur mchod bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin 'di dag 'a 'ongs

ṇi pad+me phroṃ hrīḥ dmar gsur la brten pa'i phyugs kyi nad yams gcod pa/ dang po mgron bzhi'i gsur bsngos pa'i gzhug tu/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta spa wa pho ke sogs mthar/ mtshan bzhi brjod nas/ khyad par du 'byung po mi ma yin sha za tshe 'a rku ba mdangs 'phrog pa/ sems can gzhan gyi dbugs na rngam pa/ sdang sbru ba dang gdug ge'i bas sna sbyor can mi mi nad bdag /gnag phyugs kyi god bdag la sogs pa gya 'dre 'gong po'i rigs che chung ji snyed mchis pa mkho 〉 rgu'i 'dod yon zad mi shes pa'i yongs spyod chen po/ bza' btung / gnas mal/ sha yi ri bo/ khrag gi rgya mtsho/ dus pa'i gram khrod/ bags rlon khyigo dang skra yi bsgo ba/ rkang klad nag gi char la sogs pa rang rang ci 'dod spyi dngos bro bza' bas mi zad pa/ btung bas mi bri ba/ bsgos pas mi rnying //ba/ ri tho bas 'phang mtho ba/ rgya mtsho bas gting zab pa/ chu klung bas rgyun ring ba/ nad kun sel ba'i sman mchog /'chi ba gso ba'i bdud /

pa'i paṇa grub rnam gsum/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug brgyad cu rtsa bzhi/ sham 'a'i rigs ldan chos rgya'/ rigs gsum sgru 'phrul mes dbon rnam gsum/ /mkhan thob zung gcig dang ska cog zhang gsum la sogs sprul pa'i 'o baṇa mkhas grub chen po bstan pa la bya ba mdzad nas chos kyi dbyings su zhi bar gshegs sta ba thams cad kyi thugs kyi dgongs ba zag pa med ba gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogs bar gyur cig /da ltar bzhugs ba'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa botsho bangs rtogs phun sum tshogs pa mtha' dag dang /byang chub sems kyi rigs yongs su sad ba las dngos sam brgyud nas sems can 'a sman ba'i rigs/skye sa chibu gsum gyi nam nas don gnyis bsgrub pa'i 'dun pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi bzhed don 'bad med du 'grub cing sku tshe'i rgyal mtshan yun ring du brtan par /gyur cig /dge 'dun ma lus pa rgyal bas gnang ba'i zas gos gnas mal gyis chog shes zhing / chos spyod bcu dang 'brel bar brjod bya bslab ba gsum /

pa'i yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig byang chub kyi yan 'ag bdun 'a sogs pa mthong 'am gyis bsdus ba'i yon tan thams cad yongs su smyordzogs par gyur cig /'pha gas pa'i lam yan lag brgyad po sogs bsgom lam gyis bsdus ba'i yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /sku gsung 7 thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo mi slob pa'i 'am gyi yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /tshul de dag gis thub pa'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa 〉 rin po che yun du gnas pa'i mthu la brten nas 'jig rten gyi khams su dus la bab pa'i char chu 'bad med du 'byung zhing yo tog 'bras bu'i yon tan phun ༵sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig /las ngan gyi rgyu las bskyed ba'i 'jigs ba chen po brgyad dang bcu drug sad ser/ btsa' than/ 'byung ba sgang gshongs/ mi nad phyugs nad dmag 'khrugs mu gi /gdon gyi gnod pa spru sogs pa'i dus kyi chad pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig /skye dgu thams //

nus par gyur cig /'jam dpal dpa' thos ji ltar mkhyen pa dang / sogs dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni/ /'gro don thugs la dgongs 'grub shog /mgon po yis ni gang dgongs pa/ /sems can rnams la de 'byung shog /phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas gcig pu/ sogs brjod gshin bsngo ni//ga de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin 'a sa mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor yo'i cho 'phrul gyi bkod pa'i zhing khams rab 'byams rdul tho4 snyed na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa 'jig rten pha rol du nying mtshams sbyar ba'i las kyi gzhan dbang can che ge mos thog drangs pa'i chi sems can thams cad la thugs rje'i gzigs pa lhur mdzad de dgongs su gsol/ de nyid 'a sogs pa'i sems can gang zhig 'chi rka'i bar do 'a gnas na ming gzhi'i phung po dang rnam par shes pa'i tshogs brgyad chos nyid 'dus ma byas pa'i dbyings su nye bar zhi nas mi slob pa'i lam gyi yon tan mngon du gyur te /

bar gyur cig /gti mug mtshungs ldan gyi rang gzugs dud 'gro bkol spyod kyi sdug bsnga' las grol zhing thar bar gyur cig /phrag dog mtshungs ldan gyi rang gzugs lha min 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal las grol zhing thar bar gyur cig /nga rgyal mtshungs ldan gyi rang gzugs lha 'pho lhung gi sdug bsngal mas grol zhing 7 thar bar gyur cig /mi g.yo ba'i las dang stoms 'jug bzhi'i rang gzugs bsam ga 1na gzugs med kyi 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal mas grol zhing thar bar gyur 〉 cig /mdor na rten 'brel lugs 'byung gis bsdus pa'i 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las myur du thar nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang rin po che thob par gyur cig /de ma thob kyi bar du'ang mtho ris kyi yon tan bdun dang ldan ba'i rten la dpe 'byor gyi chos bco brgyad tshang ba'i lus rten khyad par can thob par gyur cig khyad par du gzhon nu nyid nas nges 'byung gi sems dang ldan pas rgyal ba'i bstan pa la 'jug cing yang dag pa'i

zhiḥ pad+ma 'byung: tshul brtul zhugs spyod pa'i he ru ku: ma mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas: sku mtshan dpe'i gzi byin ta 'a la: gsung gang 'dul chos sgra 'u ru ru: thugs 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i ngang: bu mos gus drag pos gsol ba 'debs: phyi rnam rtog dgrar langs lha 'dre'i gzugs:shā nang re ngang dogs pa'i gnyis 'dzin sems: bar snang ba sna tshogs rkyen ngan kun: chos zab mo bdud kyi gcod yul gyis: dus da lta stan thog 'di ru ju2 chod: dbyings chos sku'i rgyal sa zin pa du: pha rje btsun bla mas byin gyis rlobs: phaṭa: phaṭa: phaṭa: ces brjod tshogs zhing rang la bstim: gnyis tso med ngang du mnyam par bzhag: phaṭa: de nas bag chags snyigs ma'i lus: tsho zhing snam la stos che ba'i: dbus nas dwangs ma'i rig pa ni: khros ma'i rnam par phaṭa ces dbye: zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod can: de yis rang lus thod pa phral: stong khams khyab pa'i mi mgo yi: skyed pu gsum gyi khar

sde brgyad 'byung po mi ma yin: 'og 'dren sha za'i gdon tshogs la: stong gsum khyab pa'i zhing thags steng: sha khrag dus pa'i phung por 'bul: bdag /tu 'dzin na nga re zhan: spyod du ma nus khyod re 'od: rings na rjen par khyar mid thong: stod na dum bur tshos la tho: rdul min tsam yang ma bzhag cig:phaṭa: 'khor tshe thog ma med pa nas: sha 'khon chags pa'i lan chags dang: glo bur lhags pa'i snying rje'i mgron: khas nyan dbang chung ma lus la: chuso so gang la ci 'dod kyi: 'dod yon mi zad gter du bsngo: 'brel pa thogs tshad sangs rgyas shang: bu yon lan chags byang bar shog: phaṭa: ces / gru brjod stos pa med par sbyin: stong nyid ngang las mnyam par gzhag: de tshe lus la gces 'dzin dang: 'jigs snang 'khu 'phrig blo skyes na: lus ni lha 'drer byin nas med: sems ni gzhi med rtsa ba bral: 'dre bas sangs rgyas nyid kyis kyang: gzigs pa med snyam gdeng bskyed la: gang shar rang ngo rtsa gdar bcad: thogs bcas bdud dang

sgrub pa'i bar chad kyi dbang du mi 'gro bar dkon mchog bsum gyi skyabs 'og tu tshud de skyes bu gsum gyi 'am 'a slob par 'og cig /bde gshegasaku na 'dus kyi ngo tho bka' drin can gyi bla ma dam pa 'a ze tshom dang mnyam 'grogs kyis mi ru bzung ba'i yog lta spangs te sangs rgyas dngos su mthong bar nisgog /ste: cig /de'i mthu pos mtshon byed dpe'i dbang ba/gis sgo gsum smin par byas te rmad byung rdo rje theg pa'i gsang lam 'a 'jug par shog cig /gso la 'debs / shetsho dang mos gus kyi mtshams sbyor smum du yongs nas mtshon bya don gyi dgongs rgyud bdag 'a 'phros te rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par shos/ cig /bskyed pa / tshim hā yo ga'i /nyams len mthar phyin nas snod bcud dkyil 'khor gsum du shes zhing rig 'dzin rnam pa bzhi'i sa 'a bgrod ba rgyal sras pad+ma dang be+e ma ma lta bur 'gyur bar zhog cig /phung rna nu yo ga'i nyams len mthar phyin nas 'khor 'das kyi 'dzin rtog bde stong gnyis su med ba'i ngo thor sangs rgyas te 'og /
